Khách hàng doanh nghiệp trong ngành ngân hàng, tài chính, bán lẻ, logistics, y tế...Trách nhiệm chínhĐánh giá thị trường SaaS và CPaaSXây dựng và duy trì bản đồ thị trường CPaaS, Meta Business Suite, Zalo Business Solutions, Contact Center, AI Agent, các đối thủ quốc tế và các nền tảng nội địa.Theo dõi tín hiệu thị trường theo các luồng ưu tiên: Meta & Zalo (zClaw), các nền tảng Agentic OS, chính sách AI quốc gia, Open Banking API (Casso, SePay, Tingee...).Chuẩn bị báo cáo thị trường định kỳ và báo cáo chuyên đề theo yêu cầu của CEO.Phân tích và định hướng phát triển sản phẩmChuyển hóa chiến lược “Sell the pipes, not the AI” thành lộ trình sản phẩm đồng bộ, đảm bảo mỗi sản phẩm nằm đúng ở tầng hạ tầng, không lấn sang tầng ứng dụng.Thiết kế mô hình kinh doanh, bảng giá và cơ chế đóng gói (Resource caps, Feature flags theo Tenant, Consumption caps) phù hợp mô hình đại lý/phân phối qua đối tác SaaS.Xây dựng, duy trì bộ tài liệu sản phẩm: Product vision, Roadmap, PRD, đặc tả tích hợp.Phân tích luồng dữ liệu liên công ty và đảm bảo yêu cầu tuân thủ Nghị định 13/2023 về bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân được đưa vào thiết kế sản phẩm ngay từ đầu (thỏa thuận chia sẻ dữ liệu, chỉ định bên kiểm soát theo từng luồng, lưu trữ dữ liệu trong nước).Xây dựng MVP và trình bày luồng nghiệp vụMọi đề xuất sản phẩm gửi CEO phải đi kèm MVP chạy được, không chỉ dừng ở Wireframe.Với mỗi luồng nghiệp vụ đề xuất (ví dụ: OTP qua ZBS Template → fallback SMS; Agent thoại chuyển tiếp nhân viên; đối soát giao dịch ngân hàng → thông báo ZBS Template), xây dựng MVP hoàn chỉnh từ đầu đến cuối: giao diện, logic, tích hợp API, dữ liệu mẫu.Sử dụng thành thạo công cụ AI (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Lovable...) và công cụ No-code/Low-code (n8n, Make...) để rút ngắn thời gian từ ý tưởng đến bản chạy thử.Trình bày luồng nghiệp vụ chi tiết cho CEO: sơ đồ luồng, kịch bản người dùng, điểm tích hợp, rủi ro tuân thủ, và demo trực tiếp trên MVP.Đo lường và ghi nhận kết quả MVP (giả định nào được xác nhận, giả định nào bị bác bỏ) để làm cơ sở quyết định đầu tư phát triển chính thức.Chuyển giao MVP đã được duyệt cho đội kỹ thuật cùng PRD, tiêu chí chấp nhận và User story đầy đủ để lên kế hoạch phát triển sản phẩm chính thức.Phối hợp và vận hành sản phẩmQuản lý Product backlog, ưu tiên hóa theo giá trị kinh doanh và tính khả thi; điều phối Sprint cùng đội kỹ thuật.Làm việc trực tiếp với đối tác hệ sinh thái và đại lý SaaS để thu thập yêu cầu, chạy thử tích hợp và thu nhận phản hồi.Chuẩn bị tài liệu và Slides trình bày với đối tác chiến lược theo chuẩn nhận diện eTelecom (Deck sản phẩm, One-Pager, tài liệu tích hợp).Tổ chức tri thức sản phẩm có hệ thống để CEO và đội ngũ tra cứu, kế thừa.

Khách hàng doanh nghiệp trong ngành ngân hàng, tài chính, bán lẻ, logistics, y tế...Trách nhiệm chínhĐánh giá thị trường SaaS và CPaaSXây dựng và duy trì bản đồ thị trường CPaaS, Meta Business Suite, Zalo Business Solutions, Contact Center, AI Agent, các đối thủ quốc tế và các nền tảng nội địa.Theo dõi tín hiệu thị trường theo các luồng ưu tiên: Meta & Zalo (zClaw), các nền tảng Agentic OS, chính sách AI quốc gia, Open Banking API (Casso, SePay, Tingee...).Chuẩn bị báo cáo thị trường định kỳ và báo cáo chuyên đề theo yêu cầu của CEO.Phân tích và định hướng phát triển sản phẩmChuyển hóa chiến lược “Sell the pipes, not the AI” thành lộ trình sản phẩm đồng bộ, đảm bảo mỗi sản phẩm nằm đúng ở tầng hạ tầng, không lấn sang tầng ứng dụng.Thiết kế mô hình kinh doanh, bảng giá và cơ chế đóng gói (Resource caps, Feature flags theo Tenant, Consumption caps) phù hợp mô hình đại lý/phân phối qua đối tác SaaS.Xây dựng, duy trì bộ tài liệu sản phẩm: Product vision, Roadmap, PRD, đặc tả tích hợp.Phân tích luồng dữ liệu liên công ty và đảm bảo yêu cầu tuân thủ Nghị định 13/2023 về bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân được đưa vào thiết kế sản phẩm ngay từ đầu (thỏa thuận chia sẻ dữ liệu, chỉ định bên kiểm soát theo từng luồng, lưu trữ dữ liệu trong nước).Xây dựng MVP và trình bày luồng nghiệp vụMọi đề xuất sản phẩm gửi CEO phải đi kèm MVP chạy được, không chỉ dừng ở Wireframe.Với mỗi luồng nghiệp vụ đề xuất (ví dụ: OTP qua ZBS Template → fallback SMS; Agent thoại chuyển tiếp nhân viên; đối soát giao dịch ngân hàng → thông báo ZBS Template), xây dựng MVP hoàn chỉnh từ đầu đến cuối: giao diện, logic, tích hợp API, dữ liệu mẫu.Sử dụng thành thạo công cụ AI (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Lovable...) và công cụ No-code/Low-code (n8n, Make...) để rút ngắn thời gian từ ý tưởng đến bản chạy thử.Trình bày luồng nghiệp vụ chi tiết cho CEO: sơ đồ luồng, kịch bản người dùng, điểm tích hợp, rủi ro tuân thủ, và demo trực tiếp trên MVP.Đo lường và ghi nhận kết quả MVP (giả định nào được xác nhận, giả định nào bị bác bỏ) để làm cơ sở quyết định đầu tư phát triển chính thức.Chuyển giao MVP đã được duyệt cho đội kỹ thuật cùng PRD, tiêu chí chấp nhận và User story đầy đủ để lên kế hoạch phát triển sản phẩm chính thức.Phối hợp và vận hành sản phẩmQuản lý Product backlog, ưu tiên hóa theo giá trị kinh doanh và tính khả thi; điều phối Sprint cùng đội kỹ thuật.Làm việc trực tiếp với đối tác hệ sinh thái và đại lý SaaS để thu thập yêu cầu, chạy thử tích hợp và thu nhận phản hồi.Chuẩn bị tài liệu và Slides trình bày với đối tác chiến lược theo chuẩn nhận diện eTelecom (Deck sản phẩm, One-Pager, tài liệu tích hợp).Tổ chức tri thức sản phẩm có hệ thống để CEO và đội ngũ tra cứu, kế thừa.

Kinh nghiệm và kiến thứcTối thiểu 3 năm kinh nghiệm ở vị trí Product Owner / Product Manager trong lĩnh vực SaaS, CPaaS, Fintech, Contact Center hoặc nền tảng API B2B.Trực tiếp đưa ít nhất 1 sản phẩm B2B từ giai đoạn ý tưởng đến ra mắt và có doanh thu.Hiểu sâu mô hình kinh doanh nền tảng (Platform), mô hình đại lý / White-Label, định giá theo tiêu dùng (Usage-based) và theo kết quả (Outcome-based).Có kiến thức về API / Webhook, Multi-tenant và kinh nghiệm các mảng: nhắn tin (Zalo OA / ZBS Template, SMS), thoại (SIP / VoIP / Contact Center), Open Banking API.Có khả năng phân tích thị trường và cạnh tranh một cách có hệ thống, viết báo cáo ngắn gọn, đi thẳng vào hàm ý và đề xuất cụ thể.Kỹ năng AI và xây dựng MVPTrợ lý AI cho phân tích:Sử dụng thành thạo Claude / ChatGPT hoặc tương đương cho nghiên cứu thị trường, viết PRD, phân tích tài liệu đối tác, tạo slides và tài liệuAI Coding / Vibe Coding:Xây được ứng dụng web hoàn chỉnh bằng Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, hoặc tương đương; đọc hiểu và chỉnh sửa code được AI sinh raTự động hóa, tích hợp:Dựng luồng nghiệp vụ end-to-end với n8n / Make / Zapier; gọi REST API, xử lý webhook, mock API khi chưa có hệ thống thậtPrompt & Agent design:Thiết kế Prompt, Tool Definition (MCP / Function Calling), kịch bản hội thoại cho AI Agent; hiểu giới hạn và rủi ro của LLMThiết kế UI/UX :nhanh Figma hoặc AI Design Tool để dựng Wireframe / Prototype có thể tương tác trong vài giờ Ưu tiênDữ liệu SQL:cơ bản, đọc hiểu mô hình dữ liệu, dựng Dashboard đo lường MVP Ưu tiênTiêu chuẩn đầu ra:trong vòng 3–5 ngày làm việc, PO phải tự xây dựng được một MVP chạy được cho một luồng nghiệp vụ mới, có giao diện, có tích hợp (thật hoặc mock), có dữ liệu mẫu, và trình bày được trước CEO.Ưu tiênĐã làm việc trong hoặc với hệ sinh thái Zalo, Ngân hàng / Công ty tài chính, hoặc Nhà mạng / Nhà cung cấp CPaaS.Hiểu Nghị định 13/2023 về bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân và các yêu cầu tuân thủ dữ liệu trong ngành tài chính – viễn thông.Có kinh nghiệm với nền tảng PBX/Contact Center (PortSIP, Asterisk, FreeSWITCH, Genesys...), OpenClaw / Agent runtime, hoặc nền tảng Open Banking API.Kinh nghiệm khởi nghiệp hoặc làm việc trực tiếp với CEO trong môi trường Startup.

title: Senior Data Analyst (CRM & Loyalty)
company: Golden Gate
jd_text:
The Growth Analytics & Business Insights Analyst supports Growth & Loyalty activities through data analysis, performance reporting, and business insights. The role focuses on Loyalty, Loyalty-related Trade Marketing programs, customer behavior, and related digital marketing journeys. Working under the direction of the Growth Marketing Supervisor, the Analyst will prepare reports and dashboards, analyze campaign and customer performance, and help the team identify opportunities for improvement. The Analyst is also encouraged to raise questions and provide alternative perspectives when supported by data. Key Responsibilities Growth, Loyalty & Customer Analytics Analyze customer, transaction, membership, campaign, and digital interaction data to support Growth Marketing activities. Monitor key customer metrics, including acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, purchase frequency, spending, churn, and customer lifecycle. Evaluate Loyalty performance across membership tiers, customer segments, point earning and redemption, voucher usage, and promotional participation. Analyze Trade Marketing activities and digital customer journeys by relevant dimensions such as customer segment, campaign, channel, store, product, and time period. Conduct segmentation, cohort, funnel, trend, and behavioral analysis based on business requirements. Reporting & Performance Analysis Prepare recurring and ad-hoc reports for Loyalty, Trade Marketing, digital journeys, and other Growth Marketing initiatives. Develop and maintain dashboards based on KPI frameworks and reporting requirements provided by the Growth Marketing Supervisor. Track campaign performance against agreed targets, historical results, or reference groups, and summarize key outcomes after implementation. Highlight material changes, unusual movements, funnel drop-offs, risks, and areas that may require further analysis. Support the improvement and automation of recurring reports to reduce manual work and improve reporting efficiency. Business Insights & Recommendations Interpret analytical results and translate them into clear and relevant business insights. Help identify customer behaviors, performance drivers, business risks, and potential growth opportunities. Explain what changed, identify possible contributing factors, and suggest areas for further monitoring or analysis. Present findings in a concise, business-friendly format for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Raise questions or propose alternative interpretations when business assumptions are not sufficiently supported by data. Data Quality, Documentation & Collaboration Validate source data, business rules, calculation logic, and reporting outputs before sharing results. Investigate data discrepancies and coordinate with BI, Data, Technology, or system owners when support is required. Maintain clear documentation of KPI definitions, calculation methods, data sources, and reporting logic within the Growth Marketing scope. Work closely with Growth Marketing, CRM, Loyalty, Operations, Finance, BI, Data, and other relevant teams. Follow company policies regarding customer data privacy, data security, access control, and responsible data usage.

Qualifications & Experience 4+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Business Insights, CRM Analytics, Marketing Analytics, or a similar role. Experience using data to support business decisions, customer analysis, campaign evaluation, or performance reporting. Hands-on experience developing dashboards and preparing recurring or ad-hoc reports for business teams. Experience working with customer, transaction, CRM, Loyalty, campaign, or digital journey data is preferred. Experience in F&B, retail, e-commerce, consumer services, or other transaction-driven businesses is an advantage. Technical & Analytical Skills Required Strong SQL skills for data extraction, validation, reconciliation, and analysis. Good proficiency in at least one visualization tool, such as Power BI, Tableau, or Superset. Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for data analysis and business reporting. Familiarity with segmentation, cohort analysis, funnel analysis, trend analysis, and campaign performance analysis. Good analytical thinking, attention to detail, communication, and data presentation skills. Nice to Have Knowledge of statistical analysis, test and control groups, or A/B testing. Proficiency in Python or R for data manipulation or reporting automation. Familiarity with data warehouse concepts or cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Redshift, or ClickHouse. Understanding of Loyalty programs, CRM, customer lifecycle management, promotional effectiveness, or digital conversion funnels.

title: Remote AI Agent Engineer
company: Fram
jd_text:
The core product experience runs on an LLM-driven agent that extracts data from client-submitted receipts and documents over WhatsApp, proposes accounting entries, and answers staff questions inside the web app. We’re hiring an AI/Agent Engineer to take ownership of this entire layer, making it cheaper, safer and more reliable while closing specific security gaps (prompt injection, unchecked tool authorization) identified in a recent technical audit. You will work alongside a backend-leaning Fullstack Engineer, who owns the surrounding application and infrastructure. Own the LLM integration layer used for document extraction (OCR), accounting-entry proposals, and the in-app chat agent, currently built on Anthropic/OpenAI APIs Implement prompt caching to cut redundant token usage. An identified ~83% cost-reduction opportunity  and introduce per-tenant usage budgets and quotas Harden the agent against prompt injection: treat all extracted document text as untrusted input, and require explicit confirmation gates before any tool call that grants data access, creates a contact, or moves money Replace the agent’s currently hard-coded (effectively disabled) permission model with real, enforced per-tool authorization checks Evaluate and implement model tiering, cheaper models for extraction, stronger models for judgment calls and plan a fallback provider for resilience Build an evaluation/golden-file test harness so model or prompt changes can be validated before shipping to production Implement PII redaction before data is sent to third-party LLM providers, and partner with the Fullstack Engineer to log every agent tool call to an audit trail Advise on data-processing-agreement and data-residency questions for the AI sub-processors (Anthropic, OpenAI), alongside the company’s data-protection advisor Contribute to the n8n-side automation where it touches AI extraction, the document-intake pipeline and coordinating handoffs with the Fullstack Engineer.

3+ years of experience building production applications on top of LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or equivalent) Hands-on experience with agentic tool-use patterns, function/tool calling, multi-step agent loops, not just single-shot prompting Strong prompt-engineering skills, including context management and techniques for defending against prompt injection Proficiency in Python or TypeScript, sufficient to build and modify a backend AI-integration layer Experience building or using evaluation frameworks/golden-file testing for LLM-based systems Practical understanding of LLM cost structures and optimisation techniques, prompt caching, context trimming, model tiering Working knowledge of security concerns specific to LLM systems: prompt injection, data exfiltration via generated content, unsafe tool authorization Clear written communication in English; able to work asynchronously across time zones

title: Remote Fullstack Engineer (AI Experience)
company: Fram
jd_text:
An AI-native platform that lets Swiss fiduciary firms manage client bookkeeping, payroll and compliance through a WhatsApp-first workflow, backed by a Next.js/Supabase application and n8n automation. We’re hiring a backend-leaning full-stack engineer to close a critical security backlog, stabilise the platform for production use, and lay the operational groundwork, CI/CD, observability, staging are needed to onboard more customers safely. You will work directly inside the existing single-contributor codebase, take full ownership of the n8n automation layer, and be one of two engineering hires driving the technical roadmap (the other being an AI/Agent Engineer). Remediate the platform’s active security exposure: enforce authentication and row-level security (RLS) on every API route; close public database policies exposing payroll and client data; fix a tenant-isolation bug that allows cross-tenant access Replace n8n’s direct database master-key access with an authenticated ingestion API that derives tenant identity server-side, removing the single largest operational risk in the automation layer Design and implement a background job queue for heavy, currently synchronous document processing (PDF/XLSX extraction, multi-account imports) to remove request-timeout failures Make cloud storage private (signed URLs, UUID paths) and put the database schema into version control, paired with a real staging environment Build CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, including tenant-isolation regression tests and baseline observability (logging, monitoring, alerting) Harden and maintain the n8n workflows that run the WhatsApp document-intake and accounting-automation flows, including error handling, idempotency, and a dead-letter/retry path Implement data-subject-rights tooling (export/erase) and an append-only accounting ledger with reversal entries, in coordination with the company’s external data-protection advisor Redact personal data from application logs and enforce least-privilege access patterns throughout the stack Collaborate with the AI/Agent Engineer on backend integration points for the LLM-driven agent, tool authorization checks, audit logging of agent actions.

4+ years of professional experience with Node.js/TypeScript in production backend systems Strong hands-on experience with Next.js (App Router) and building/maintaining REST and webhook APIs Deep, practical knowledge of PostgreSQL, including Row-Level Security (RLS) policy design and multi-tenant data isolation Production experience with Supabase, or an equivalent BaaS (Firebase, AWS Amplify), auth, storage and database Experience with n8n, Zapier, or a comparable workflow-automation tool, ideally including securing/hardening automations that touch production data Working DevOps fluency: CI/CD pipeline design (GitHub Actions or equivalent), staging environments, secrets management, and basic monitoring/alerting setup Solid understanding of authentication/authorization patterns and common web-application security pitfalls (mass assignment, privilege escalation, injection) Comfortable working in and improving a codebase with minimal existing test coverage or documentation. You will be establishing the engineering discipline, not just following it Clear written communication in English; able to work asynchronously across time zones. Experience with Swiss or EU data-residency / GDPR-driven architecture decisions Familiarity with double-entry accounting systems, or fintech/regtech products generally Experience integrating LLM-based agents into a production backend (tool-calling, audit trails) Prior experience as the sole or lead engineer on a live production system (start-up background)

title: Mid/Sr Business Analyst (English) - 2V074
company: Tập đoàn ROX (ROX Group)
jd_text:
Phân tích & quản lý yêu cầu Thu thập, phân tích và làm rõ yêu cầu từ các đơn vị nghiệp vụ. Chuyển đổi yêu cầu nghiệp vụ thành yêu cầu chức năng/kỹ thuật phù hợp với hệ thống CNTT. Xây dựng và quản lý tài liệu: BRD, FSD, User Story, Use Case, Flow, Wireframe (khi cần). Quản lý thay đổi yêu cầu trong suốt vòng đời dự án. Thiết kế & đề xuất giải pháp CNTT Phân tích hiện trạng hệ thống, xác định gap và đề xuất giải pháp công nghệ phù hợp. Phối hợp với Solution Architect/Tech Lead để thiết kế luồng xử lý, kiến trúc logic, API, dữ liệu. Đề xuất cải tiến quy trình, tối ưu hiệu năng và trải nghiệm người dùng. Hỗ trợ phát triển & kiểm thử Phối hợp với đội phát triển trong quá trình xây dựng chức năng. Xây dựng test case, test scenario; hỗ trợ SIT/UAT. Theo dõi, phân tích và xử lý lỗi phát sinh (defect, change request). Triển khai & vận hành Hỗ trợ triển khai hệ thống lên môi trường Production. Phối hợp với các bên liên quan để đào tạo, hướng dẫn sử dụng hệ thống. Hỗ trợ phân tích sự cố, cải tiến hệ thống sau go-live.

Kinh nghiệm Tối thiểu 3 năm kinh nghiệm ở vị trí IT BA (level Middle) hoặc BA dự án CNTT (Senior: 5+ năm). Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với các dự án phát triển phần mềm, hệ thống nội bộ Ưu tiên kinh nghiệm trong domain Bất động sản, CRM, Facility Management. Kiến thức chuyên môn Hiểu SDLC, Agile/Scrum, Waterfall. Hiểu biết về hệ thống CNTT: API, database, integration, microservices là lợi thế. Có khả năng đọc hiểu tài liệu kỹ thuật, log, dữ liệu (SQL là lợi thế). Kỹ năng Kỹ năng phân tích nghiệp vụ & tư duy logic tốt. Kỹ năng viết tài liệu rõ ràng, có cấu trúc. Kỹ năng giao tiếp, làm việc với nhiều bên liên quan. Chủ động, trách nhiệm và có khả năng làm việc độc lập

title: Principal DevOps Engineer- NCP
company: NAB Innovation Centre Vietnam
jd_text:
ABOUT THE JOB We're seeking Principal, DevOps Engineer who have had a proven track record of running critical shared application platforms in a production cloud environment who will take a team-first approach and can act as a multiplier, making other engineers better at their craft. At NAB, we believe success comes from our people. We're committed to supporting your talent and skills through your career, as you help us build a culture that affects change for our customers and for the community too. YOUR JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Define and implement tools and processes to standardize and automate software development, testing, deployment, and support. Ensure consistent CI/CD practices across projects and teams. Design and deliver secure, resilient, scalable enterprise platforms and cloud solutions. Provide technical direction and present/defend architecture decisions to senior architects or architecture governance forums. Automate infrastructure deployment and rollback using Infrastructure as Code. Lead production incident investigations and drive root-cause remediation. Proactively manage production risks and improve operational resilience. Lead cross-team technical initiatives and influence outcomes without direct authority. Coach engineers and drive continuous improvement in engineering practices.

7+ years’ experience in DevOps, Cloud, or Platform Engineering across the software lifecycle. Strong AWS and/or Azure experience, including Kubernetes (AKS/EKS) . Strong CI/CD and automation experience with GitHub, Jenkins, Artifactory, Docker, and Compliance as Code . Strong understanding of microservices, APIs, distributed systems, and cloud architecture . Hands-on experience with AWS services such as EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, SNS, and CloudWatch. Strong Infrastructure as Code skills with Terraform, Ansible, Packer, and/or Python. Enterprise platform/solution design experience , with strong knowledge of reliability, security, scalability, and operational resilience . Experience presenting/defending designs to senior architects, Principal Engineers, or Architecture Review Boards . Proven technical leadership and cross-team influence without direct authority. Strong production support, incident management, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

company: Techcombank
jd_text:

title: Software System Engineer
company: Datalogic Việt Nam
jd_text:
We are seeking a Software System Engineer with strong experience in Android rugged platforms and open‑source technologies, capable of coordinating international development teams and collaborating with global ODM partners. The role involves system integration, AOSP/BSP customization, hardware–software bring‑up, and release validation across distributed engineering groups. Key strengths include leading technical discussions with overseas teams, aligning cross‑functional development efforts, managing platform deliverables, and driving issue resolution across time zones. Excellent communication skills and fluent written and spoken English are essential. Key Responsibilities: Collaborate with software, hardware, and ODM teams to define the system architecture of Android‑based rugged devices. Support AOSP and BSP, Middle ware integration, including kernel customization, device tree configuration, and HAL layer adaptation for enterprise‑grade components. Manage and coordinate technical aspects with ODM partners, software, hardware teams, including requirement definition, software release evaluation, issue monitor & analysis, and acceptance of platform deliveries. Manage the Android security features process (e.g. monthly security updates). Manage the process for automated test tools and CI/CD pipelines for Android platform builds (build systems, OTA updates, certification tests). Document system designs, platform changes, and integration processes across the entire software stack.

Technical Skills: Strong understanding of Android system architecture, including Frameworks, HAL, BSP, and kernel layers. Experience with AOSP build systems, SoC vendor trees (e.g., Qualcomm, MediaTek, NXP), and ODM‑provided customizations. Experience with embedded software development and integration of enterprise/industrial peripherals driver (2D imagers, UHF RFID, UWB, serial UART accessories, custom I/O…). Strong experience with Git and CI/CD systems supporting Android builds and automated testing. Experience with Software Development lifecycle (Agile or Waterfall) and Software Release process. Knowledge of Software validation scope and process Knowledge of Android security architecture and secure update management (OTA, FOTA, update channels). Previous experience working with ODMs or third party on custom Android device development, issue triage, and delivery validation. Soft Skills: Excellent written and spoken English, required for daily interaction with ODM and SoC vendors. Ability to collaborate closely with Software, Hardware, QA, PM, and UX teams across the full product lifecycle. Strong analytical and debugging mindset, able to work at kernel, hardware, and application interfaces. Clear and effective communication skills (especially when interacting with ODM or international technical teams). Strong Project management and Time management skill Proactive, detail‑oriented, and comfortable working in fast‑paced R&D environments. Passion for development of rugged mobile computing products, Android internals Education & Experience: Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, Computer Science, or related fields 3+ years experience with Android system development, embedded platforms, or rugged device engineering. 1+ years experience with project management

title: Senior Data Engineer (C++, Python, AI/LLM)
company: ITviec Recruitment Consulting
jd_text:
Job Responsibilities: Enrich a wide range of structured and unstructured data into high-quality datasets for quantitative analysis and financial engineering. Enhance data quality and integrity by developing validation tools and frameworks to measure the effectiveness of data enrichment pipelines. Develop a deep understanding of machine learning, deep learning, and emerging AI/LLM applications, and analyze the underlying dynamics and behaviors within the data. Generate insights from large-scale datasets and collaborate with research teams to identify opportunities for tradable signals. Design and develop utility tools to automate software development, testing, deployment, and monitoring workflows. Provide technical support for global researchers, including diagnosing root causes of technical issues, troubleshooting Python and C++ code , and proposing scalable fixes and improvements. Investigate, debug, and resolve issues in C++ applications and data pipelines , with a strong focus on performance, stability, correctness, and maintainability. Explore and apply AI/LLM-based solutions to improve data processing, workflow efficiency, troubleshooting, documentation, and research support processes.

Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering, data engineering, machine learning, AI, or related technical domains. Practical experience with, and theoretical understanding of, deep neural networks, machine learning techniques, and modern AI approaches. Demonstrated ability to implement data science pipelines and real-time applications in Python and C++. Strong experience in debugging, troubleshooting, and improving C++ code , including performance analysis, root cause investigation, and code maintainability. Familiarity with AI/LLM tools and applications, including using large language models to support analysis, automation, technical troubleshooting, or workflow optimization. Proficiency with Python-based tools such as Jupyter Notebook and coding standards such as PEP 8. Proficiency with C++ tools and concepts such as STL, object-oriented programming , and debugging best practices. Strong academic background, with a minimum of a bachelor’s degree in a technical or quantitative field. Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities, with strong attention to detail. Strong software development skills, with the ability to convert broad use cases into reliable working solutions. Motivated by curiosity, continuous learning, and solving complex technical problems. Nice to have: Experience as a data scientist or data engineer in finance or investment-related environments. Experience with Linux/Unix shell, Git, and software debugging tools. Practical experience with time-series forecasting and analysis methods. Experience applying AI/LLM technologies in engineering, analytics, data enrichment, support automation, or developer productivity use cases. Experience optimizing or troubleshooting C++-based systems in production or research environments.

title: Presales Engineer (Cloud, AWS)
company: MEGAZONE
jd_text:
MEGAZONE CLOUD is looking for a passionate AWS Cloud Pre-sales Engineer to join our growing technical sales team in Hanoi. This is an exciting opportunity to work with enterprise customers and AWS, helping organizations accelerate their cloud transformation journey. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the Sales team to understand customer business requirements and design secure, scalable, and cost-effective AWS cloud solutions. You will serve as the technical advisor throughout the sales cycle, supporting solution design, customer presentations, demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and proposal development. You will also work with AWS and internal delivery teams to ensure successful solution positioning and customer engagement. This role reports to the Head of Business. Key Responsibilities Partner with the Sales team to understand customer business and technical requirements. Design AWS cloud architectures and recommend best-fit solutions based on customer needs. Deliver technical presentations, solution demonstrations, workshops, and customer consultations. Prepare technical proposals, architecture diagrams, BOM, SOW, and supporting documentation. Respond to RFP, RFQ, and RFI requests with comprehensive technical solutions. Collaborate with AWS and internal engineering teams to develop competitive cloud solutions. Support Proof of Concept (PoC) planning and execution. Stay up to date with AWS services, cloud technologies, and industry best practices. What You Will Do BA/BS degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 2+ years of experience in Pre-sales, Solution Architecture, Cloud Engineering, or related technical consulting roles. Strong knowledge of AWS cloud services, including compute, networking, storage, databases, security, and container technologies. Ability to translate business requirements into scalable cloud architectures. Excellent communication, presentation, and customer-facing skills. Experience preparing technical documentation and proposal materials. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and collaboratively. Comfortable working in a fast-paced and customer-oriented environment.

Basic Qualifications 2–5 years of experience in Cloud Pre-sales, Solution Architecture, Cloud Engineering, or Infrastructure Consulting. Hands-on knowledge of AWS services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, EKS, Lambda, CloudFormation, and related technologies. Experience supporting enterprise customers throughout the pre-sales lifecycle. Good written and verbal communication skills in both English and Vietnamese. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Qualifications AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional. Experience working with AWS Partner organizations or cloud service providers. Knowledge of hybrid cloud, migration, Kubernetes, DevOps, or security solutions. Experience delivering customer workshops, technical demonstrations, and PoCs. Passion for learning new cloud technologies and helping customers solve complex business challenges.

title: Head of Project Management (IT Software)
company: Ambition Vietnam
jd_text:
① Quản lý tổng thể và Nâng cao chất lượng dự án Thiết lập và chuẩn hóa quy trình quản lý dự án phù hợp với từng loại hình dự án của công ty. Theo dõi, đánh giá sức khỏe dự án định kỳ thông qua các chỉ số KPIs (Tiến độ, Ngân sách, Chất lượng). Xây dựng bộ tiêu chuẩn chất lượng (Quality Gate) cho từng giai đoạn, đảm bảo sản phẩm đầu ra đáp ứng kỳ vọng của khách hàng. Giải quyết các vấn đề phát sinh mang tính hệ thống hoặc các rủi ro nghiêm trọng đe dọa sự thành công của dự án. ② Điều phối nguồn lực (Resource Management) Quản lý "Capacity" (năng suất) của toàn bộ đội ngũ, đảm bảo nhân sự được phân bổ đúng người, đúng việc và đúng thời điểm. Giải quyết các xung đột về nguồn lực giữa các dự án hoặc giữa các bộ phận. Dự báo nhu cầu nhân sự trong tương lai để phối hợp với bộ phận HR trong việc tuyển dụng hoặc đào tạo nội bộ. Xây dựng lộ trình phát triển năng lực cho đội ngũ Project Manager (PM) cấp dưới. ③ Nghiên cứu, thử nghiệm ý tưởng và Kỹ thuật mới (R&D) Dẫn dắt các dự án "Pilot" (thử nghiệm) để đánh giá tính khả thi của các công nghệ hoặc quy trình mới trước khi triển khai rộng rãi. Cập nhật các xu hướng kỹ thuật phần mềm mới nhất (AI, Automation, Low-code...) để cải tiến quy trình sản xuất hiện tại. Khuyến khích văn hóa sáng tạo trong đội ngũ, tạo không gian cho các ý tưởng đột phá về tính năng sản phẩm hoặc mô hình kinh doanh mới.

- MUST HAVE Tối thiểu 08 năm kinh nghiệm làm việc trong lĩnh vực phát triển phần mềm Tối thiểu 05 năm kinh nghiệm làm việc ở vị trí quản lý dự án phần mềm - quản lý team lớn Thông thạo việc xây dựng khung quản lý dự án (Project Management Framework), chuẩn hóa quy trình, công cụ và bộ chỉ số KPI/OKR Kinh nghiệm sử dụng các phần mềm/công cụ quản lý chuyên ngành Tư duy chiến lược: kết nối mục tiêu của từng dự án riêng lẻ với chiến lược kinh doanh tổng thể của công ty Năng lực lãnh đạo & phát triển đội ngũ: quản lý, đào tạo, truyền cảm hứng và phát triển năng lực cho các Project Manager/Scrum Master cấp dưới. Tiếng Anh lưu thoát (nói và viết), làm việc trực tiếp với đối tác/khách hàng - NICE TO HAVE Suy nghĩ tích cực và tinh thần "can do" Kỹ năng làm việc, đàm phán và thuyết phục đối tác, khách hàng và các bộ phận liên quan Kinh nghiệm làm việc tại các công ty Nhật

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (Laravel)
company: CÔNG TY TNHH DU LỊCH WAYFINDER HOLIDAYS
jd_text:
WayFinder Holidays là công ty du lịch tại Việt Nam, phục vụ các thị trường quốc tế. Chúng tôi đang tuyển Senior Full-stack Developer (Laravel) làm việc tại văn phòng Hà Nội, trực tiếp phát triển và vận hành website cùng các hệ thống web liên quan của công ty. Bạn sẽ làm việc cùng developer hiện tại trên codebase PHP/Laravel đang vận hành. Công việc gồm phát triển tính năng, xử lý lỗi, tích hợp dịch vụ bên thứ ba và bảo trì hệ thống sau khi đưa vào sử dụng. Đây là vị trí senior. Bạn cần có khả năng tự xử lý phần việc kỹ thuật được giao, đề xuất phương án phù hợp và theo công việc đến khi release. Trọng tâm là Laravel backend. Bạn làm việc với HTML, CSS và JavaScript ở mức đủ để hoàn thiện tính năng; kinh nghiệm Vue hoặc React là điểm cộng, không bắt buộc. Bạn hỗ trợ một số công việc cơ bản về deployment và hosting khi cần, nhưng không phụ trách toàn bộ IT hay MarTech của công ty. Trong 12 tháng tới, WayFinder Holidays dự kiến xây dựng team Technical riêng. Senior Developer phù hợp có thể được cân nhắc cho vai trò Tech Lead khi team mở rộng, dựa trên năng lực kỹ thuật, khả năng tự chủ công việc và khả năng hỗ trợ các developer khác. Phát triển, chỉnh sửa và bảo trì các chức năng trên website bằng PHP/Laravel Làm việc cùng developer hiện tại để triển khai tính năng theo kế hoạch và yêu cầu nghiệp vụ Đưa ra phương án kỹ thuật cho các tính năng hoặc thay đổi quan trọng trước khi triển khai Review code và cùng developer hiện tại giữ codebase rõ ràng, ổn định và dễ bảo trì Rà soát các vấn đề về code, hiệu năng, bảo mật và độ ổn định; đề xuất những phần cần ưu tiên xử lý Tiếp tục phát triển trên codebase có sẵn; xử lý bug và khắc phục các vấn đề ảnh hưởng đến độ ổn định của hệ thống Phát triển và duy trì các chức năng liên quan đến sản phẩm tour, luồng gửi yêu cầu và đặt tour, biểu mẫu và dữ liệu khách hàng Xây dựng và duy trì kết nối API với CRM, email và các nền tảng bên thứ ba khi có yêu cầu Làm việc với MySQL, bao gồm thay đổi cấu trúc dữ liệu, truy vấn và xử lý các vấn đề phát sinh Kiểm tra tính năng trước khi release; đảm bảo website hoạt động ổn định trên desktop và mobile Hỗ trợ các công việc kỹ thuật cơ bản liên quan đến deployment, hosting/VPS, domain, DNS, SSL, backup và cập nhật hệ thống Phối hợp với các bộ phận liên quan để làm rõ yêu cầu và triển khai các chức năng mới Ghi lại các thay đổi kỹ thuật, cấu hình và tích hợp quan trọng để hệ thống có thể được tiếp quản và bảo trì thuận lợi

Tối thiểu 4 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển web, trong đó ít nhất 3 năm PHP/Laravel trên dự án đã vận hành Nắm vững PHP, Laravel và MySQL; thành thạo OOP, MVC và thiết kế cơ sở dữ liệu Đọc hiểu và tiếp quản được codebase do người khác viết Từng chủ trì ít nhất một hệ thống hoặc mảng chức năng từ yêu cầu, triển khai đến khi vận hành Có kiến thức làm việc với HTML, CSS và JavaScript Có kinh nghiệm xây dựng hoặc tích hợp REST API và các dịch vụ bên thứ ba Sử dụng Git tốt trong môi trường làm việc nhóm Có khả năng debug và xử lý vấn đề kỹ thuật độc lập; chủ động trao đổi sớm khi có blocker Hiểu về bảo mật web, tối ưu hiệu năng và môi trường server/deployment Giải thích được quyết định kỹ thuật cho người không chuyên Có khả năng đọc hiểu tài liệu kỹ thuật bằng tiếng Anh Cẩn thận, có trách nhiệm và theo sát công việc đến khi hoàn thành Điểm cộng Đã làm website booking, e-commerce, travel hoặc hệ thống có nhiều luồng nghiệp vụ Có kinh nghiệm tích hợp payment gateway, CRM, email automation hoặc các dịch vụ bên ngoài Biết Vue.js, React hoặc một frontend framework tương đương Có kinh nghiệm với Linux/VPS, Docker, CI/CD hoặc cloud hosting Có kinh nghiệm triển khai GA4/GTM ở góc độ kỹ thuật Có kinh nghiệm sử dụng AI coding tools như GitHub Copilot, Cursor hoặc ChatGPT trong quá trình phát triển

title: Full-stack Developer (Java / Go · Angular / ReactJS)
company: LEAP
jd_text:
Prefer immediate employment / ƯU TIÊN ĐI LÀM NGAY Develop back-end APIs using Java (Spring Boot) and/or Go — both are used across our new projects. Design and work with relational databases ( PostgreSQL ) — schema, migrations, queries. Integrate with third-party service providers over REST and SOAP, and make those integrations resilient when the provider is slow or down. Work with Kafka for asynchronous processing and event-driven flows. Develop user interfaces in JavaScript / TypeScript / HTML5 / CSS3 using Angular or ReactJS , responsive on desktop and mobile browsers. Consume your own APIs from the client, including streaming responses where results arrive progressively rather than all at once. Work with shared packages in a monorepo — shared business logic, generated API clients and a design system. Test, commit and integrate your code with our online products. Work as part of an AI agent team — set up and run AI agents that implement, review and verify work under your direction.

You do not need to be equally strong on both sides. You do need to be genuinely productive on both — able to take a feature from the database to the screen without handing it over halfway. Experienced with Java (Spring Boot, Java 17+) and/or Go . Strong in one and willing to work in the other is fine; strong in both is better. Solid understanding of REST API design , and of documenting an API as a contract (OpenAPI). Working knowledge of relational databases — transactions, indexing, and why a query is slow. Experience integrating third-party APIs : timeouts, retries, and knowing which operations are safe to retry and which are not. Experienced with Angular or ReactJS and TypeScript . Being able to work in both is a big plus — we run both, and people who move between them are the ones who see the pattern instead of the framework. Experience with micro-frontends — module boundaries, independent deployment, and the versioning and caching problems that come with them. Solid HTML5 / CSS3 and responsive layout skills. Experience handling server state properly (TanStack Query, SWR, RxJS or similar) — not everything in a global store. Experience building forms and data tables at real complexity — validation, server-side errors, multi-step flows. Awareness of accessibility and keyboard interaction as a default, not a retrofit. A product mindset about UI/UX. You care how the screen actually feels to use, and when a design or a requirement looks wrong you say so instead of building it silently. We would rather have the argument before the sprint than the rework after it. Comfortable with automated testing on both sides as part of your normal workflow, not as a separate phase. Strong interest in software design, programming and testing. Prefer immediate employment. Proficient, hands-on experience with AI coding agents in daily development work. Able to set up an AI agent team — define agent roles, skills and gates so a feature can be split across several agents and still come back consistent. Proficient in prompt engineering — you can turn a vague requirement into instructions an agent executes reliably, and keep it on the project's conventions. Experience setting up an agent harness : project-level instruction files, custom commands and skills, sub-agents with scoped tools and permissions, hooks for the rules that must always hold. Loop engineering — you build an objective verifier and let the agent iterate against it instead of reviewing output by eye. On the back end that means unit tests, type checks and architecture or lint gates; turning a rule you would otherwise repeat in code review into an automated check is the core skill. On the front end it means more than "it compiles" — you also give the agent a way to observe the rendered result (for example a browser-automation screenshot or an accessibility snapshot). Candidates who have closed that visual loop are rare and we want them. Experience setting up AI code review — automated review in the pull-request flow, tuned so it catches real defects instead of producing noise everyone learns to ignore. Experience building an autonomous agent team — agents that plan, implement, review and verify, with a human at the gates — is a strong advantage. Critical evaluation of AI output. You can spot a diff that looks correct and quietly breaks a business rule, and a component that renders fine in the demo and falls apart on real data or a slow network. You are empowered by AI — and you are accountable for everything it produces on your behalf. This is the single most important expectation of the role. We want you to lean on AI heavily; "the AI wrote it" is never an explanation for a defect that reached production. Experienced with DevOps activities is a remarkable plus — reading and writing Kubernetes manifests, building your own service's CI pipeline, and debugging your service from outside (logs, metrics, traces) rather than waiting for the platform team. Experience with penetration testing and security best practices is a big plus — OWASP Top 10, authorization checks that hold when an identifier comes from outside, secret handling, and remediating a real finding rather than reading about one. Experienced with Linux. Experience with Keycloak / OAuth2, or Redis. Experience with React Native — some of our shared business logic is used by mobile apps too. Experience with Tailwind, Radix, or building a design system with multi-brand tokens. Experience with end-to-end testing (Playwright or Cypress). Experience in travel, e-commerce, fintech or any domain with money and third-party providers involved. Graduated in Vietnam National University, Ho Chi Minh City is a big plus.

title: Business Analyst Leader
company: CÔNG TY TNHH NEXTEDGE
jd_text:
Job summary: The Business Analysis Leader is responsible for leading, developing, and continuously improving the Business Analysis team and BA practices across the company. The role will ensure high-quality business analysis and effective collaboration between business stakeholders, project teams, and technical teams. A key focus of this role is to drive the adoption of AI and modern technologies within Business Analysis activities to reduce manual effort and time consumption, improve the quality and consistency of BA deliverables, and increase overall team productivity. The BA Lead will establish BA standards and best practices, coach and train BA team members, identify opportunities to apply AI and automation in BA workflows, and support project delivery, solutioning, and pre-sales activities as required. Core Responsibilities: Lead, mentor, coach, and develop the Business Analysis team. Manage BA resource planning, workload, and project assignments. Establish and maintain BA standards, methodologies, templates, and best practices. Drive the adoption of AI, automation, and modern tools to improve BA productivity and quality. Identify and implement AI use cases across requirements, documentation, analysis, testing, and knowledge management. Develop and share AI-assisted BA workflows, techniques, and best practices. Train and guide BAs to effectively and responsibly use AI in their daily work. Ensure the quality, consistency, and traceability of BA deliverables. Oversee requirements elicitation, analysis, documentation, validation, and prioritization. Review and approve key BA artifacts before delivery. Collaborate with stakeholders to align business needs with solution delivery. Support project planning, estimation, scope management, and risk mitigation. Drive continuous improvement of BA processes, tools, and ways of working. Build and maintain the BA knowledge base, reusable assets, and AI-assisted knowledge resources. Track BA team performance, productivity, quality, and AI adoption.

Job requirement: At least 7 years of working experience in Business Analysis, with experience in leading or mentoring BA team members . Strong experience in BA activities for enterprise software systems and projects. Strong understanding of software development processes and requirement analysis. Hands-on experience using Generative AI/LLM tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Gemini, or equivalent tools. Practical understanding of how AI can be applied to requirements analysis, documentation, process analysis, testing, and other BA activities. Ability to develop effective AI prompts, workflows, and use cases to improve BA productivity and quality. Ability and willingness to train, coach, and guide BA team members in applying AI. Good understanding of AI limitations, data privacy, security, and responsible AI usage. Strong leadership, coaching, and team development skills. Good command of English communication skills (speaking, listening, reading, and writing). Strong stakeholder management, presentation, facilitation, and client relationship skills. Good UI/UX knowledge and experience. Experience in UML, business process modeling, and data modeling. Good technical background and understanding of software architecture, APIs, databases, and system integration. Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Experience in Agile/Scrum and software development lifecycle. Excellent proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Proactive, innovative, flexible, conscientious, responsible, and results-oriented. Willing to continuously learn and experiment with new AI and technology trends. Hard-working and able to work under pressure to meet deadlines. Education: Bachelor's degree in IT, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or related fields. Nice to have: Experience supporting pre-sales, solutioning, RFP/RFQ, or proposal activities is a plus. Overseas education or international working experience is a plus.

– Quản lý, điều phối và phát triển đội ngũ 3D (3D Artist/Designer) để đảm bảo tiến độ và chất lượng công việc.– Xây dựng kế hoạch, phân công công việc và theo dõi tiến độ dự án 3D.– Đảm bảo chất lượng sản phẩm 3D đáp ứng yêu cầu kỹ thuật và thẩm mỹ.– Phối hợp với các bộ phận liên quan (thiết kế, kỹ thuật, sản xuất, marketing...) để triển khai dự án hiệu quả.– Đề xuất, cải tiến quy trình, công cụ và tiêu chuẩn làm việc của nhóm 3D.– Đào tạo, hỗ trợ và phát triển năng lực cho các thành viên trong nhóm.– Báo cáo tiến độ, kết quả công việc và các vấn đề phát sinh cho cấp trên.

title: Software Engineer (HTML5, JavaScript/TypeScript, .NET)
company: Scandinavian Software Park
jd_text:
is a software company that develops business systems for the Life and Pensions industry. Join Lumera's dynamic Product Development team in Hanoi as we expand our presence in the European Life and Pensions industry. We're seeking a Full Stack Software Engineer with strong frontend expertise to help drive our innovative solutions forward as we build tomorrow together. Excited? Submit your application now! What you’ll be doing: Collaborating with Agile teams to build and enhance our cutting-edge, market-leading life and pensions products. Designing and developing customer-facing web applications using ASP.NET Core and Umbraco CMS. Building responsive, accessible and maintainable user interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and related client-side technologies. Integrating frontend applications with internal and external REST-based services. Working with authentication, identity management and security solutions including Azure AD, SAML and MFA. Designing, developing and testing our software as well as post-release maintenance. Working with colleagues in the UK, India, Sweden, and Vietnam. Learning, teaching, and executing – together with your team.

Skills Required Technical Skills – Must Haves 5+ years of professional software development experience, with significant experience delivering frontend-focused web applications. Strong experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, jQuery, SASS (SCSS) , responsive design and cross-browser compatibility. Strong experience with front-end UI libraries , client-side scripting and AJAX-based applications . Strong understanding of software engineering principles including SOLID, clean code. Experience with ASP.NET Core MVC and legacy .NET framework. Solid understanding of SOAP & RESTful API design. Familiarity with authentication and authorization concepts including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML or MFA . 2+ years of hands-on experience working with Entity Framework and LINQ. Experience writing unit and integration tests with good coverage. Technical Skills – Nice to Have Hands-on experience with Umbraco CMS would be advantageous. Knowledge of React and related modern frontend tooling. Understanding WCAG accessibility guidelines. Experience building dashboards and data visualizations using libraries such as Chart.js Experience with messaging and event-driven architectures (e.g., RabbitMQ, MassTransit). Experience with real-time web applications and background job processing frameworks. Experience with cloud-native services and observability tools on AWS or Azure. Experience with Docker and containerization technologies. Experience with CI/CD pipelines. Understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD ). Non-Technical Skills Proactive in proposing solutions and collaborating with key stakeholders in and outside of the team. Positive attitude to working together and delivering as a team. Able to guide and mentor more junior team members. Able to work within an international development team. A good command of spoken and written English which is used to communicate between the teams in various countries.

title: Technical Business Analyst
company: Hitachi Digital Services
jd_text:
Role Overview Join our delivery team as the vital link between business ambitions and technical execution. You will collaborate with stakeholders to elicit high-precision requirements, shape technical solutions, and oversee the lifecycle from discovery through to successful deployment. Key Responsibilities Elicitation & Negotiation: Lead workshops to capture needs, mediate conflicting stakeholder priorities, and negotiate project scope boundaries effectively. Interface Documentation: Author precise Software Specifications (SRS) and System Interface Specifications (ICD), defining communication protocols for seamless cross-system data exchange. System Integration: Analyze external interfaces, constraints, and non-functional requirements within complex system architectures. Analysis & Problem Solving: Identify process logic gaps, propose cost-effective solutions, and perform rigorous impact analysis on system baseline changes. Communication: Act as a translator between technical constraints and business value for all project members and customers. Testing & Traceability: Facilitate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and maintain end-to-end requirement traceability. Prototyping: Develop UI/UX mockups for HMI or web applications to validate functional flows and system interfaces.

Experience: 2+ years of proven experience as an IT Business Analyst. Communication: Fluent English (able to conduct interview and presentation in 100% English); skilled at steering clients toward feasible technical paths. Technical Expertise: Strong background in technical writing, elicitation, and system interface analysis. Familiarity with software communication standards is preferred. Methodology: Solid grasp of SDLC frameworks (Waterfall, Agile, or Scrum). Education: Degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related technical field. Soft Skills: Acute attention to detail, proactive self-management, and advanced logical/critical thinking.

title: Middle QA Automation Engineer (Playwright, Selenium)
company: FPT Digital
jd_text:
1. Automation Testing (Core Focus): Design, build, and maintain automated test scripts using frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress for core system workflows. Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to ensure release quality and continuous delivery. Perform API testing (using Postman, RestAssured, or API automation libraries) and execute regular regression testing. 2. Test Strategy & Quality Mindset: Analyze business requirements (SRS/User Stories) and Acceptance Criteria to create comprehensive Test Plans and Test Cases covering Happy Paths, Edge Cases, and Boundary Conditions. Conduct functional testing (Web/App UI), workflow validations, and perform SQL database checks to verify data integrity and consistency. Log, track, and manage defect lifecycles on Jira; collaborate closely with Developers and PMs to resolve issues efficiently. 3. AI & LLM Feature Testing: Test AI/LLM-driven product features (e.g., AI Chatbots, automated data extraction, RAG workflows). Evaluate AI output quality based on established criteria: accuracy, completeness, source attribution, and detection of AI hallucinations (incorrect or fabricated responses). Test different prompt variations to compare performance, answer stability, and response consistency. Leverage modern AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to accelerate test case generation, test data creation, and script writing.

1. Experience & Quality Assurance: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 2–4 years of experience in software testing (Manual and Automation). Strong QA Mindset: Excellent analytical skills, attention to detail, strong logic for identifying system flaws, edge cases, and effective bug-hunting. 2. Automation & Tech Stack (Must-have): Proficiency in at least one UI Automation framework ( Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress ) with corresponding programming languages (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Java). Solid hands-on experience in API testing with Postman or API automation libraries. Proficiency in writing SQL queries to query, validate, and verify system database records. 3. AI Exposure & Willingness to Learn: Prior experience testing AI/LLM features OR active use of GenAI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) in daily QA workflows. Open, curious mindset with a strong passion for specializing in AI Quality Assurance .

title: Data Leader
company: MYMIND
jd_text:
ABOUT THE COMPANY With over 10 years of relentless innovation, MyMind Joint Stock Company (MSM) is redefining the future of enterprise management. We deliver smart, scalable digital solutions that power business transformation across industries—from enterprises and agriculture to smart manufacturing. By combining deep domain expertise with cutting-edge technology, MSM helps organizations worldwide simplify complexity, accelerate growth, and lead with confidence in the digital era.

ABOUT THE POSITION The Data Leader owns the data function at MSM end-to-end: the data platform (lake, warehouse, DaaS), the data team, and the alignment between data and the business domains we serve — Ecommerce, ERP/DMS, and AgriTech. The role is hands-on at the architecture level while being accountable for people, delivery, and standards. 1. Responsibilities a. Team leadership & mentoring Lead, coach, and mentor the data engineering team (Senior/Middle/Junior); run 1:1s, define growth paths, and conduct performance reviews. Set technical standards through design reviews, code reviews, and pairing — raise the team's bar rather than doing all the hard work alone. Build the hiring pipeline: define role profiles, interview, and onboard data engineers and analysts. b. Resource coordination & delivery Plan, allocate, and rebalance team capacity across squads/projects (DigiRetail, DigiFarm, DigiFactory, DigiO) based on priority, risk, and deadlines. Own the data roadmap and backlog — break business requests into epics/stories, estimate effort, track delivery, and report status to management and stakeholders. Manage cross-team dependencies with product, backend, DevOps, and data science; unblock the team and escalate early. c. Business & domain alignment Understand the business data models of Ecommerce (orders, catalog, inventory, promotions, customer/CRM/CDP), ERP/DMS (sales-distribution, finance, procurement, warehouse), and AgriTech (field, crop, GIS, IoT/sensor). Translate business KPIs into data products: define metrics, dimensional models, and data contracts with product owners and domain experts. Act as the primary data counterpart for stakeholders (Product, Finance, Operations, Customers/Partners) — and own data governance, data quality, and access policies. d. Platform & architecture Architect and evolve the data platform: batch/streaming pipelines, data lake/lakehouse, warehouse, and DaaS/API layers for analytics, applications, and partners. Develop and maintain GIS data systems enabling geospatial analytics and field-level monitoring. Optimize storage and compute cost/performance across on-premise and cloud; enforce infrastructure-as-code, versioning, and reproducibility. Drive AI/ML enablement on the platform: feature pipelines, model serving integration, and AI- ready data architecture (advantage — see Nice to Have). 2. Requirements a. Must Have Skills Experience: 7+ years in data engineering / data platform, including 2+ years leading a data team (3+ members) with direct people-management responsibility. Leadership & mentoring: proven track record of growing engineers, running design/code reviews, and setting team standards. Resource & delivery management: capacity planning, prioritization, estimation, and status reporting across multiple concurrent projects; hands-on with Jira/agile delivery. Business domain knowledge: solid understanding of Ecommerce and/or ERP/DMS data (transactional models, master data, KPIs, reconciliation, reporting needs); experience working directly with business stakeholders. Core technical skills: Proficient in Python and SQL for data transformation and automation. Strong experience with distributed processing frameworks(e.g.,Apache Spark, Flink). Experience designing and operating data lakes/lake houses and warehouses(e.g.,Iceberg, Delta Lake, BigQuery, Redshift). Experience designing APIs or DaaS platforms for data delivery. Solid knowledge of data modeling (Kimball, DataVault , or similar) and data governance/quality frameworks. Familiarity with semi-structured and unstructured data (JSON, geospatial, IoT, sensor data). title: Project Manager - Supply Chain Operations
company: Crossian
jd_text:
Crossian is a high-growth technology-driven e-commerce business. Behind our success is our people. As a start-up formed in 2020, we have created a fast-paced and dynamic environment, enabling our people to reach a cumulative average growth rate of over 1000% in the last 3 years. Our mission now is to build DTC brands and increase customer LTV by providing best-valued products backed by no nonsense customer service policies as Customer Centricity is at the core of our values. As a Supply Chain Project Manager, you're expected to be a self-starter who takes initiatives. A take-charge person who is obsessed with problem solving and trying to find the best solutions and alternatives to a problem. A team player who leads by example, and able to champion processes that make team members accountable and productive. WHAT YOU WILL DO 1️⃣ Project Management Project portfolio management : Prioritize project pipeline with the SCE Manager, balance resources across concurrent projects, and ensure on-time, desired-quality delivery. Project execute: Execute end-to-end project across the following streams - SCM system/tech development, operational expansion, and cross-functional process improvement. Budgeting and planning: Build budgets, track spend, and keep projects within approved cost. Establish project governance : Establish lightweight but effective PMO governance from the ground up - planning standards, milestone and timeline tracking, risk & dependency management, and contingency planning for a growing company. Status reporting: Provide SCE & Crossian leadership with weekly status reports including progress, issues, risks, and decisions requirement management support. 2️⃣ Resource & Capacity Planning Internal resources: Build and maintain the SCE-wide human resource and team capacity view across functions (Merchandising, Fulfillment, QC, Sourcing/PM), covering both projects and daily operations. Analyze team workload against demand and operational/project pipeline; identify capacity gaps and over-allocation. Provide reallocation and hiring-need recommendations to the SCE Manager, and input capacity constraints into project portfolio prioritization. External resources: Run periodic capacity planning cycles with the Production, Fulfillment, and Partner Management Teams to build and validate production, fulfillment and partner acquisition plans - ensuring they are reasonable relative to sales demand and achievable with current and planned capacity. Manage the approved plans and track progress; flag deviations early and drive corrective actions 3️⃣ People Management Manage, mentor, and grow the Project Coordinator team; drive recruitment and development paths. Allocate PCs to projects and ensure consistent coordination quality across the portfolio. 4️⃣ Process & Knowledge Management Champion agile ways of working within SCE. Ensure project documentation and knowledge repositories are complete, organized, and accessible.

Bachelor's degree in Business Management/Administration, Project Management, or Logistics & Supply Chain Management or related field from a recognized university. 5–7+ years , including 3+ years of hands-on project management with multiple concurrent projects — preferably e-commerce, tech-driven, or supply chain businesses. Proven analytical and data skills (Excel/Sheets, BI tools) for capacity/workload modeling and budgeting. Experience in S&OP/supply planning, PMO, or software development projects is a competitive advantage. English Fluency. Proven ability to work with ambiguity and translating complex concepts into project deliverability and accountability. Portfolio management and prioritization capability; comfortable making resource trade-off recommendations. Strong analytical and planning capability: workload/capacity modelling, gap analysis, and budget management. Excellent communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

As a Supply Chain Project Manager, you're expected to be a self-starter who takes initiatives. A take-charge person who is obsessed with problem solving and trying to find the best solutions and alternatives to a problem. A team player who leads by example, and able to champion processes that make team members accountable and productive. WHAT YOU WILL DO 1️⃣ Project Management Project portfolio management : Prioritize project pipeline with the SCE Manager, balance resources across concurrent projects, and ensure on-time, desired-quality delivery. Budgeting and planning: Build budgets, track spend, and keep projects within approved cost. Allocate PCs to projects and ensure consistent coordination quality across the portfolio. 4️⃣ Process & Knowledge Management Champion agile ways of working within SCE. Ensure project documentation and knowledge repositories are complete, organized, and accessible.

Experience in S&OP/supply planning, PMO, or software development projects is a competitive advantage. English Fluency. Portfolio management and prioritization capability; comfortable making resource trade-off recommendations. Strong analytical and planning capability: workload/capacity modelling, gap analysis, and budget management. Excellent communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

title: Principal Java Engineer
company: NAB Innovation Centre Vietnam
jd_text:
ABOUT THE JOB We are seeking motivated Principal Java Engineer who are passionate, results focused contributing to the transformation of NAB’s payment acceptance experience through innovation, digitisation, and integration. You will be part of our delivery team and will be responsible for providing technical leadership throughout all phases of the software delivery life cycle as we initiate a transformation of NAB technology. At NAB, we believe success comes from our people. We're committed to supporting your talent and skills through your career, as you help us build a culture that affects change for our customers and for the community too. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Provide hands-on leadership to the design, development, and deployment of technical solutions; Collaborate with other NAB's technology leaders towards improving and fulfilling the NAB technical direction; Evangelise and promote Java best practices; Be passionate about Java and understand how to implement advancement for existing or new systems; Lead and conduct training to empower engineers on sufficient programming skills; Design, develop, review, implement, and manage Java application code and services for the production and pre-release environments; Design, develop, review, implement, and manage continuous integration, build management and deployment scripts, systems, and any code as required; Participate in Agile software development, prototyping, and code review with international development teams to build scalable microservices-based products and APIs using Java technologies on AWS or Azure cloud architecture; Understand the requirements of the customer or business and utilize this knowledge to develop applications that are consistent with this; Work with delivery teams to achieve success through development using CI/CD and DevOps practices, processes, and tooling; Provide robust coding practices, solid unit/component test coverage, and debugging code; Fulfil other tasks as assigned by your People Leader and/or authorized representative of NAB Vietnam from time to time.

Minimum of 12+ years' experience as a similar role (Technical Lead, Technical Architect, Principal Engineer,...) in Software Development in a complex, enterprise-level development environment; solid in architecting, developing, and deploying modern architectural patterns/techniques (microservices, DDD, TDD ...) Solid experience in Java 11+, Java open-source frameworks, including developing using modern frameworks, e.g. Spring Boot, Spring Cloud,... Solid experience in designing & developing RESTful APIs and microservices-based system Experience supporting a production service in a DevOps friendly environment with solid experience in Cloud-based services (AWS/Azure/...) Well-versed in writing structured, well-documented, maintainable, and clean code; Excellence in problem-solving and analytical skills; Strong understanding of standard Software Engineering processes, Testing, and Agile methodology; Strong understanding of secure coding practices and application security; Strong work ethic, self-motivation, dedication, and commitment Solid experience in Agile development environments; Excellent teamwork and coaching skills Strong English communication skills (both verbal & written), especially in the global software development environment; Nice-to-have Experience in the Banking or Financial Services industry; Experience in JavaScript frameworks, specifically React.js and Node.js; Any additional certification or training in IT, Business, Computer Science, or related area;

company: ProNgân hàng SHB
jd_text:
Xây dựng chiến lược và kế hoạch kiểm thử tự động phù hợp với hệ thống và dự án.Thiết kế, phát triển và bảo trì automation framework theo hướng dễ mở rộng, tái sử dụng.Phát triển test scripts cho UI/API/Integration/Contract testing.Thực hiệnPerformance Testing: xây dựng kịch bản kiểm thử hiệu năng, tải và stress test; phân tích bottleneck và đề xuất tối ưu hệ thống.Tích hợp automation vào pipeline CI/CD, đảm bảo feedback nhanh cho đội phát triển.Phân tích kết quả test, xử lý lỗi và tối ưu độ ổn định của automation suite.Phối hợp với Dev, BA, QA trong toàn bộ vòng đời phát triển phần mềm.Nghiên cứu, đề xuất và áp dụng các công nghệ/công cụ automation mới.(Đối với Senior) Hướng dẫn, mentoring và nâng cao năng lực đội ngũ.

title: Senior/Techlead .NET Developer (C#, OOP, SQL)
company: RIKKEISOFT
jd_text:
Tham gia phát triển hệ thống backend sử dụng C#/.NET trong dự án cho khách hàng Nhật. Phân tích yêu cầu, thiết kế và xây dựng các module chức năng, tối ưu hiệu suất hệ thống. Viết code theo chuẩn clean code, đảm bảo khả năng bảo trì và mở rộng. Tham gia review code, viết tài liệu kỹ thuật và hỗ trợ team trong quá trình phát triển. Thực hiện unit test, fix bug và hỗ trợ QA để đảm bảo chất lượng sản phẩm. Phối hợp chặt chẽ với BA, QA, PM và các thành viên khác trong nhóm để đảm bảo tiến độ và chất lượng dự án.

Senior: từ 7 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển phần mềm với C#/.NET. Ưu tiên tính từ khi tốt nghiệp. Hiểu biết tốt về OOP, Design Pattern, RESTful API, SQL Server/Oracle. Kỹ năng xử lý và tối ưu cơ sở dữ liệu. Có khả năng phân tích logic, giải quyết vấn đề và làm việc nhóm. Có kinh nghiệm làm detail design. Kỹ năng code tốt, có khả năng overview kiến trúc code. Đã từng làm từ 2 ngôn ngữ trở lên. Tư duy hệ thống tốt, có mindset review sản phẩm. Biết sử dụng tool AI LLM trong phát triển phần mềm là điểm cộng. Biết cách tạo workflow AI, tối ưu skill AI là điểm cộng. Từng tham gia dự án waterfall là điểm cộng. Có kinh nghiệm tham gia test, C++,.. là điểm cộng. Có kinh nghiệm làm việc trong dự án cho khách hàng Nhật là lợi thế.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
company: Timo
jd_text:
About Timo Launched in 2015, Timo pioneered digital banking in Vietnam with a mission to make banking faster, simpler, and more accessible. Today, as part of one of Southeast Asia’s leading digital financial services platforms, Timo is building secure, scalable, and customer-first digital banking experiences for millions of users across Vietnam. We are looking for curious minds and driven talents from fintech, digital banking, and technology companies who are excited to move fast, build meaningful products, and help shape the future of banking in Vietnam. About the Role We are looking for a Principal Backend Engineer to help shape the engineering foundations behind Timo's digital banking platform. In this role, you will own the core engineering platform , building internal frameworks, improving developer experience, and driving engineering best practices across teams. You will help Timo's engineers ship faster, build more reliably, and scale efficiently. You will report to the Head of Engineering . What You Will Do Architect and build internal frameworks, SDKs, and reusable components that streamline development across Timo's engineering teams Drive engineering standards in API design, microservices, observability, and performance optimization Improve developer experience (DevEx) through self-service tooling, automation, and CI/CD improvements Lead technology evaluation : research, run PoCs, and contribute to Timo's and Kredivo's Tech Radar Strengthen observability : ensure logging, tracing, and monitoring scale seamlessly with the platform Partner with DevOps to optimize CI/CD pipelines and cloud cost efficiency Influence cross-functionally across Backend, Mobile, Data, and Security teams to drive organization-wide initiatives Mentor senior engineers and drive adoption of platform tools and best practices Architect and evolve scalable backend and platform solutions using Java, Spring Boot, microservices, Kubernetes, Kafka/RabbitMQ, and event-driven architectures Provide technical leadership on system design, architecture, performance optimization, and complex production troubleshooting

What We Are Looking For Experience 6+ years of backend engineering experience, with prior experience in a Principal, Staff, or technical leadership role Proven track record of building production systems at scale Background in Platform Engineering, fintech, banking, payments, or Developer Experience is preferred Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot (4+ years), microservices, Kubernetes, Kafka/RabbitMQ, distributed systems, and cloud-native application architectures Skills & Expertise Strong expertise in building internal frameworks, SDKs, or developer tooling Deep knowledge of distributed systems, microservices, and software architecture Experience evaluating and adopting new technologies, running PoCs, and maintaining a Tech Radar Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure , observability, caching, event-driven systems, and deployment automation Skilled at defining and driving engineering standards : API design, performance, reliability Familiarity with event-driven and distributed system patterns. Excellent debugging and problem-solving skills across complex, multi-service environments Professional working English : daily collaboration with Timo leadership and Kredivo's regional engineering teams

title: Senior QA Engineer (Automation, Selenium, Playwright)
company: Zeya Labs AI
jd_text:
What This Role Is At Zeya Labs, we build enterprise software that delivers real business value — which means quality isn't a checkpoint at the end, it's built into how we work. As a Senior QA Engineer (Automation), you will own quality across the full software development lifecycle, from test strategy through release validation, for applications that our customers run their operations on. You will design and maintain the automation frameworks that keep our regression, API, and integration testing fast and reliable, while also driving the practices — defect management, root cause analysis, release sign-off — that let the wider team ship with confidence. This is a hands-on technical role and a quality-leadership role at the same time: you write the scripts, and you also set the standard other engineers are held to. Concretely, you are responsible for three things: End-to-End QA Ownership Lead QA activities across the full software development lifecycle — test planning, execution, defect management, and release validation Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts for web, API, and regression testing Create test strategies, test plans, and test cases, and hold the line on quality standards across releases Perform functional, integration, regression, API, and database testing across enterprise applications Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, Project Managers, and other stakeholders to ensure delivery quality Own the defect lifecycle end to end — triage, root cause analysis, and the continuous-improvement loop that follows Support UAT, deployment validation, production verification, and post-go-live activities Mentor junior QA engineers and champion QA best practices across the team

What We Are Looking For 5–8+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, including automation testing Strong experience with automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, or similar Experience in API testing and automation (Postman, REST Assured, or similar) Experience with enterprise applications — Finance, ERP, Estate Management, or other business workflow systems Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, SDLC, testing processes, and defect management Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar) Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills You Will Work Across This role spans multiple layers of the QA function depending on release needs: Automated test frameworks spanning web, API, and regression suites Enterprise domains such as Finance, ERP, Estate Management, and business workflow systems CI/CD pipelines, embedding automated testing directly into the delivery process UAT, deployment validation, and production verification through to post-go-live support Mentoring and QA process improvement across the wider engineering team Nice to have: experience leading QA activities or mentoring QA teams, and exposure to cloud-based applications or performance testing There's no quality function to coast on here — you are building and running it. We're looking for someone who treats automation as a craft, not a checkbox, and who wants ownership over how quality gets built into enterprise software from the ground up.
