title: [Operational Risk] _IT Risk
company: HDBank
jd_text:
1. Tham gia xây dựng, duy trì khung quản lý rủi ro công nghệ (chính sách, quy trình, khẩu vị rủi ro, chỉ số rủi ro trọng yếu - KRI) phù hợp thông lệ quốc tế và quy định của NHNN. 2. Thực hiện đánh giá rủi ro CNTT đối với các hoạt động thay đổi, nâng cấp, triển khai hệ thống mới và xử lý sự cố CNTT. 3. Thực hiện thẩm định rủi ro đối với các giải pháp/công nghệ mới (Fintech, Open Banking, Cloud) trước khi chính thức đưa vào vận hành. 4. Đánh giá rủi ro CNTT của các đối tác, nhà cung cấp dịch vụ thuê ngoài (Outsourcing). 5. Phối hợp giám sát hiệu quả các chốt chặn kiểm soát CNTT, quản lý quyền truy cập và bảo mật thông tin. 6. Tham gia xây dựng, rà soát và trực tiếp giám sát hoạt động kiểm thử kế hoạch duy trì hoạt động kinh doanh (BCP) và khôi phục thảm họa (DRP). 7. Theo dõi rủi ro an ninh mạng (Cyber Risk), phối hợp với Khối CNTT nâng cao mức độ trưởng thành an ninh mạng của Ngân hàng. 8. Giám sát, tổng hợp và báo cáo độc lập về các sự cố CNTT, mức độ ảnh hưởng và hiệu quả khắc phục. 9. Phối hợp với Khối CNTT thực hiện phân tích nguyên nhân gốc rễ (RCA), giám sát việc triển khai các hành động khắc phục (Action Plan) nhằm hạn chế nguy cơ tái diễn sự cố. 10. Báo cáo Quản trị: Thực hiện các báo cáo định kỳ/đột xuất về rủi ro công nghệ, bao gồm các chỉ số rủi ro trọng yếu (KRI) và mức độ tuân thủ khẩu vị rủi ro, theo yêu cầu của Khối QLRR & PCTT và Ban Lãnh đạo. 11. Đào tạo & Nâng cao nhận thức: Phối hợp xây dựng, triển khai các chương trình đào tạo, truyền thông nhằm nâng cao nhận thức và văn hóa quản lý rủi ro công nghệ trong toàn Ngân hàng.

Tốt nghiệp đại học trở lên các chuyên ngành Công nghệ thông tin, Khoa học máy tính, Hệ thống thông tin, An toàn thông tin hoặc lĩnh vực liên quan Có kinh nghiệm làm việc trong lĩnh vực kiểm soát tuân thủ hoạt động, kiểm soát và đánh giá rủi ro CNTT. Có kiến thức về các nền tảng và thành phần hệ thống CNTT như mạng, bảo mật, máy chủ, lưu trữ, hệ điều hành, cơ sở dữ liệu, lập trình ứng dụng, ... Có kinh nghiệm tham gia triển khai dự án quản lý an ninh thông tin theo tiêu chuẩn ISO/IEC 27001:2013. Am hiểu các khung/tiêu chuẩn quản lý rủi ro công nghệ và an toàn thông tin quốc tế (ISO/IEC 27001, NIST, PCI-DSS...) và các quy định của Ngân hàng Nhà nước, pháp luật Việt Nam về an toàn hệ thống thông tin, an ninh mạng, bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân. Có hiểu biết về các công nghệ, xu hướng mới nổi trong ngành ngân hàng (Cloud, AI/GenAI, Blockchain...) và các rủi ro công nghệ liên quan. Ưu tiên ứng viên có các chứng chỉ chuyên môn về kiểm toán, an toàn thông tin và quản lý rủi ro công nghệ.

title: Chief Technology Officer (AI, Software Architecture)
company: Zeya Labs AI
jd_text:
Zeya Labs builds the systems, models, and data infrastructure for a group operating across broad industries — including financial services, real estate, retail, healthcare, and more — in Southeast Asia. Real backing, real scale, real stakes. Almost none of it has a technology backbone yet. We are a small AI-native engineering team based in Ho Chi Minh City, and the central technology delivery engine for that group. We are not a consultancy. We do not hand off blueprints. We build, run, and own what we ship. That's the opportunity here: no legacy architecture to inherit, no decade of technical debt to manage around, no entrenched way of doing things to unwind. You'd be one of the first people deciding how this gets built, secured, and run — at group scale, from close to zero. WHAT THIS ROLE IS This is a new, senior role, and it owns the technology function. You report to the CEO and are accountable for everything: architecture, security, testing, how software gets built and run, and the teams that build it — consistently, as we scale into new industries and new group entities. This only works if you stay close to the work. Everyone at Zeya Labs is hands-on, including you. Concretely, the CTO is responsible for three things: Leading AI-native delivery, for real. You've shipped complex AI products into production, not pilots or proofs of concept — this is a hard filter. You know from experience why conventional scrum ceremonies and fixed pods are often the wrong shape for AI-native work, and you have an actual point of view on what to run instead. Owning the engineering organization. Building and running the team as it scales — hiring, developing engineering leadership under you, and being the technical voice the board and senior stakeholders trust without needing it re-explained. Building the operating system. Designing the standards for architecture, security, testing, and delivery before scale forces them on us — not after an incident makes them unavoidable.

You have built engineering structure at an organizational level before — standards, governance, how work actually gets done — not just run a team executing inside a structure someone else designed. That's the differentiator. Plenty of people can manage delivery well; what's rare is having built the system delivery runs on, and having done it ahead of a crisis, not in response to one. You have genuine, delivered experience shipping AI-integrated systems into production — not coursework, not demos, not a certification. You understand where AI tooling helps, where it creates fragility, and how conventional team structures often fight against how AI-native work actually gets done. You are still hands-on and technically credible, not someone who has moved fully into frameworks and slides. Ideally you've worked inside financial services or another regulated environment, since parts of this group carry real compliance weight. You are comfortable holding your own in a board or governance conversation without hiding behind jargon. You'd rather design the system once than firefight the same problem in every new team. You can go from setting direction to getting hands-on when something needs it, without it feeling like a step down. You're motivated by scale and blank space, not by inheriting something already built.

title: Project Manager (English Good, Business Analysis)
company: PowerGate Software
jd_text:
1. As a Software PM, you will : Lead end-to-end product development projects, from early discovery and idea validation to delivery and post-launch support. Work closely with founders and stakeholders to clarify product vision, refine business goals, and translate ambiguous ideas into structured roadmaps and execution plans. Act not only as a project manager, but also as a product-thinking partner — proactively identifying risks, gaps, and improvement opportunities in both business and technical aspects. Define project scope, objectives, timelines, and success metrics aligned with product outcomes. Prepare and manage budgets based on scope, team structure, and delivery strategy. Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope and budget, while maintaining high product quality and customer satisfaction. Manage client relationships professionally, serving as a trusted advisor rather than just a task coordinator. Create and maintain comprehensive documentation including requirement definitions, roadmaps, risk logs, and performance tracking. Measure project and product performance to identify areas for improvement and optimization. Nice to Have (Additional Advantage): Strong Business Analysis capability (requirement elicitation, stakeholder mapping, process modeling, product validation). Experience working in product studio environments or building products from early-stage ideas. Hands-on experience utilizing AI tools in project delivery (e.g., ChatGPT, coding agents, AI-assisted documentation, backlog generation, workflow automation).

At least 3–5 years of experience in software project management. Proficient in both verbal and written English (ielts >=7.0). Be able to communicate with customer on daily basis. Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and facilitating all Scrum ceremonies. Scrum certification such as PSM I, CSM, or an equivalent certification. Demonstrated ability to: Coordinate and facilitate meeting discussions effectively. Proactively ask questions, clarify requirements, and define clear action items. Monitor project progress, risks, dependencies, and team commitments. Manage Jira, product backlog, sprint planning, and release planning. jd_text:
1. Tham gia trực tiếp vào quá trình xây dựng và phát triển sản phẩm chứng khoán cơ sở/chứng khoán phái sinh trên các nền tảng (App/web), kênh bán hàng trực tiếp, kênh bán đối tác và hệ thống vận hành, phối hợp với các bên thiết kế luồng trải nghiệm khách hàng, luồng vận hành và kinh doanh sản phẩm.2. Xây dựng quy trình, quy định, chính sách sản phẩm. Xây dựng hệ thống báo cáo để kiểm soát, đánh giá hiệu quả hoạt động kinh doanh của các sản phẩm do bộ phận phát triển.3. Nghiên cứu, thu thập thông tin, phân tích về thị trường, nhu cầu của khách hàng về sản phẩm, từ đó thiết kế và nâng cấp hệ thống, sản phẩm.4. Phối hợp với Marketing, kênh bán đào tạo truyền thông sản phẩm, các chương trình và chính sách/cơ chế bán hàng.5. Phối hợp với lực lượng thúc đẩy bán, và lực lượng bán hàng trực tiếp để đưa sản phẩm đến tay khách hàng, đồng thời xử lý các vấn đề phát sinh liên quan đến quyền lợi, nghĩa vụ của khách hàng trong quá trình phân phối bán lẻ sản phẩm;6. Thực hiện các công việc khác theo yêu cầu của CBQL.

title: Data Engineer (English required, Ho Chi Minh/Ha Noi)
company: Fullerton Health
jd_text:
We are looking for a Data Engineer to support the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data pipelines and enterprise-wide data platforms to power AI-driven healthcare automation systems. You will have the opportunity to work alongside one of Southeast Asia’s leading AI teams, applying cutting-edge AI and LLM technologies to solve complex, real-world healthcare challenges at scale. From enabling agentic automate processing to building AI-ready data lakes, this role sits at the core of our regional AI transformation journey. Key Responsibilities: - Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines (batch + near real-time) - Integrate data from multiple sources (Claims, Member Data, Finance, APIs, Applications, CMS) - Build and optimize data models for analytics and AI training - Work with Azure Data Services (Blob, Data Lake, Azure SQL, Service Bus, etc.) - Ensure data quality, validation, and logging mechanisms - Support AI model training by preparing structured datasets - Assist in building dashboards for operations monitoring

- Because of recruitment needs, we accept Vietnamese candidates only - 2–5 years of experience in Data Engineering - Strong Python + SQL skills - Experience with data pipelines (Airflow / Prefect / Azure Data Factory / similar) - Familiar with cloud platforms (Azure preferred) - Experience handling structured + semi-structured data - Experience leveraging AI/ML techniques to enhance data processing, database optimization, data quality monitoring, or intelligent data workflows is a plus - Excellent written and spoken English; able to communicate effectively with regional and global stakeholder is a plus

title: Nổi bậtCHUYÊN VIÊN QUẢN LÝ SẢN PHẨM - Product Owner (PO - Base Tech) Viettel Solutions
company: TỔNG CÔNG TY GIẢI PHÁP DOANH NGHIỆP VIETTEL - CHI NHÁNH TẬP ĐOÀN CÔNG NGHIỆP - VIỄN THÔNG QUÂN ĐỘI
jd_text:
Mục tiêu vị trí:Quản lý chiến lược, vòng đời phát triển và hiệu quả kinh doanh của danh mục sản phẩm. (Ưu tiên ứng viên domain CLOUD, base Tech)Trách nhiệm chính:Định hướng và phát triển tầm nhìn, chiến lược và lộ trình sản phẩm (Product Vision, Strategy, Roadmap) dựa trên mục tiêu kinh doanh và nhu cầu người dùng.Nghiên cứu thị trường, phân tích đối thủ cạnh tranh, thu thập và phân tích phản hồi của khách hàng để xác định các cơ hội và tính năng sản phẩm tiềm năng.Thu thập, phân tích và ưu tiên các yêu cầu từ các bên liên quan (kinh doanh, marketing, khách hàng, kỹ thuật) để xây dựng Product Backlog.Chuyển đổi các yêu cầu kinh doanh thành các User Story, Epic rõ ràng, chi tiết cùng với Acceptance Criteria.Quản lý và ưu tiên Product Backlog, đảm bảo các tính năng được phát triển phù hợp với chiến lược sản phẩm và mang lại giá trị kinh doanh tối ưu.Phối hợp chặt chẽ với đội ngũ thiết kế (UI/UX) và đội ngũ phát triển (Developer Team) trong suốt vòng đời phát triển sản phẩm để đảm bảo sản phẩm được triển khai đúng hạn và đạt chất lượng.Đánh giá hiệu suất sản phẩm sau khi ra mắt, thu thập phản hồi từ người dùng và dữ liệu để đưa ra các cải tiến liên tục.Truyền đạt tầm nhìn sản phẩm, cập nhật tiến độ và kết quả cho các bên liên quan một cách rõ ràng và hiệu quả.Đảm bảo sản phẩm đáp ứng các mục tiêu kinh doanh và mang lại trải nghiệm tốt nhất cho người dùng cuối.

Học vấn:Tốt nghiệp Đại học loại Khá trở lên chuyên ngành CNTT, Điện tử Viễn thông, Kinh tế hoặc các ngành liên quan.Ngoại ngữ:Tiếng Anh đạt TOEIC 550+ hoặc có chứng chỉ tương đương.Tối thiểu 3 năm kinh nghiệm làm việc ở vị trí Product Owner hoặc Product Manager trong lĩnh vực Công nghệ Thông tin.Tốt nghiệp Đại học trở lên các chuyên ngành liên quan đến Công nghệ thông tin, Kinh tế, Quản trị kinh doanh hoặc các ngành có liên quan.Có kiến thức sâu rộng và kinh nghiệm thực tế về các phương pháp phát triển sản phẩm linh hoạt Agile/Scrum.Khả năng thu thập, phân tích yêu cầu nghiệp vụ và chuyển đổi thành các tài liệu đặc tả sản phẩm (Product Requirement Document - PRD), User Story, Acceptance Criteria rõ ràng.Kỹ năng quản lý Product Backlog, ưu tiên tính năng và lập kế hoạch lộ trình sản phẩm một cách hiệu quả.Có tư duy sản phẩm nhạy bén, khả năng phân tích thị trường và đối thủ cạnh tranh để đưa ra quyết định chiến lược.Khả năng làm việc hiệu quả với các công cụ quản lý dự án và sản phẩm như Jira, Confluence, Trello.Kỹ năng giao tiếp, trình bày, đàm phán và thuyết phục tốt với các bên liên quan (stakeholders) ở nhiều cấp độ.Khả năng tư duy logic, giải quyết vấn đề và đưa ra quyết định dựa trên dữ liệu (Data-driven decision making).Ưu tiên ứng viên có kiến thức về UI/UX và có thể sử dụng các công cụ prototyping (Figma, Sketch, Balsamiq) là một lợi thế.

title: Fullstack Developer (.NET, ReactJS)
company: TMA Solutions
jd_text:
Job Description: We are looking for a skilled Fullstack Developer with strong experience in .NET (C#) for backend development and React.js for frontend interfaces. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining end-to-end web applications that are robust, scalable, and user-friendly. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across the entire technology stack and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. Key Responsibilities: Design and develop high-quality web applications using ASP.NET Core for the backend and React.js for the frontend Collaborate with product managers, UI/UX designers, and other developers to implement new features Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code across both frontend and backend layers Create and consume RESTful APIs and ensure seamless data exchange between client and server Integrate third-party services and APIs as required Ensure application performance, scalability, and security Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback Write unit and integration tests to ensure reliability and quality Maintain documentation and contribute to continuous process improvements

Required skills/Experience: 2 years of experience in .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core) backend development 2 years of hands-on experience with React.js, Redux, and modern JavaScript (ES6+) Strong knowledge of SQL Server, Entity Framework, or other ORM tools Familiarity with frontend build tools (Webpack, Vite) and package managers (npm, yarn) Experience with REST APIs, web services, and client-server architecture Proficient with Git and version control workflows Solid understanding of software development best practices, including Agile methodologies Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (Software Engineering). TOEIC score: ≥650 or an equivalent level of English proficiency Nice to have: Experience with TypeScript and modern React features (Hooks, Context API) Familiarity with Azure or other cloud platforms Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices Experience with testing frameworks (e.g., xUnit, Jest, Cypress) Understanding of microservices architecture is a plus Years of experiences: >2 YoE

title: Senior Software Engineer (Node.js, React, Java, Kotlin)
company: Thoughtworks Vietnam
jd_text:
Senior Software Developers collaborate with Business and Quality Analysts, Designers, Project Managers and more to design software solutions that will create meaningful change for our clients. They listen thoughtfully to understand the context of a business problem and write clean and iterative code to deliver a powerful end result whilst consistently advocating for better engineering practices. By balancing strong opinions with a willingness to find the right answer, Senior Software Developers bring integrity to technology, ensuring all voices are heard. For a team to thrive, it needs collaboration and room for healthy, respectful debate. Senior Developers are the technologists who cultivate this environment while driving teams toward delivering on an aspirational tech vision and acting as mentors for more junior-level consultants. You will leverage deep technical knowledge to solve complex business problems and proactively assess your team’s health, code quality and nonfunctional requirements. You will learn and adopt best practices like writing clean and reusable code using TDD, pair programming and design patterns You will use and advocate for continuous delivery practices to deliver high-quality software as well as value to end customers as early as possible You will work in collaborative, value-driven teams to build innovative customer experiences for our clients You will create large-scale distributed systems out of microservices You will collaborate with a variety of teammates to build features, design concepts and interactive prototypes and ensure best practices and UX specifications are embedded along the way. You will apply the latest technology thinking from our to solve client problems You will efficiently utilize DevSecOps tools and practices to build and deploy software, advocating devops culture and shifting security left in development You will oversee or take part in the entire cycle of software consulting and delivery from ideation to deployment and everything in between You will act as a mentor for less-experienced peers through both your technical knowledge and leadership skills

You have experience as a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, with strong hands-on expertise in Node.js, React, TypeScript, and Java , alongside exposure to Kotlin. You are comfortable leveraging AI-assisted development tools and agents responsibly and effectively in your workflow. You can skillfully write high-quality, well-tested code and you are comfortable with Object-Oriented programming You are comfortable with Agile methodologies, such as Extreme Programming (XP), Scrum and/or Kanban You have a good awareness of TDD, continuous integration and continuous delivery approaches/tools Bonus points if you have working knowledge of cloud technology such as AWS, Azure, Kubernetes and Docker You enjoy influencing others and always advocate for technical excellence while being open to change when needed Presence in the external tech community: you willingly share your expertise with others via speaking engagements, contributions to open source, blogs and more You’re resilient in ambiguous situations and can approach challenges from multiple perspectives

title: Business Analyst (Middle)
company: Saigon Technology
jd_text:
Support PM in the pre-sales process by analyzing, clarifying, and understanding what clients are looking for, then working closely with developers/technical leaders to provide solution overviews, writing proposals, and presenting them to client Gathering information from various stakeholders and document those requirements in required formats Analyzing and documenting processes into diagrams (BPMN standard if required) Anticipating uncovered areas and proposing solutions Working closely and continuously with key stakeholders to make sure the whole project team are on the same page from raw requirements to implementations Transfer knowledge to development team Analysing change requests and anticipating their impacts on current system Support in application testing process: verifying test cases Work on internal projects to manage daily operation of the company

MUST HAVE SKILLS Fluent in English (equivalent IELTS 6.5+) 3 year of Business Analyst experience preferred Experience in reading, analyzing, and developing diagrams (UML, BPMN 2.0) Experience in working with Agile model and software development team Experience in working with the international team NICE TO HAVE Experience in working with Agile model Have PSM I or PSM II certificates Experience with mockup design tools: Moqups, Mockflow, Wireframe Experience with RDBMS: MySQL/PostgreSQL/MSSQL/Oracle Experience working in Finance/Accounting domain is a plus

title: Project Manager (Insurance)
company: Techcombank
jd_text:
Techcom Life – A Proud Member of Techcombank Ecosystem As part of Techcombank’s integrated financial ecosystem, Techcom Life is built on a strong foundation of Health and Wealth , with a mission to empower individuals to live life to the fullest. We accompany each customer on their journey to achieve their aspirations, delivering holistic financial and well-being solutions that create lasting value. Guided by the belief that true growth comes from the harmony of strength, security, and balance, Techcom Life brings together innovation, expertise, and care to help life grow bigger every day. JOB PURPOSE - The job holder leads portfolio management by providing support in planning, coordination of financial objectives and deliverables for the portfolio of both traditional projects/initiatives implemented through Waterfall methodology and customer journey digitization initiatives implemented through Agile methodology. - The job holder collaborates with cross-functional teams within the Transformation Office and other divisions in the company to ensure operational consistency across company initiatives in tracking and governing progress, managing resources and communicating with stakeholders. Key Accountabilities A. Operations Support and Governance - Design the operational process across the initiative lifecycle to ensure standartized approach across all type of initiatives/projects. - Update operational processes on a regular basis and facilitate the set up of new initiatives and tribes in accordance with required standards. - Support the development of tools/templates and guide initiative teams on how to fill in and update initiative progress on the tools/templates created. - Apply and maintain tools/templates used to track and report across the portfolio of transformation initiatives (Foundational and Agile), define monitoring tools/templates and customize as needed. - Provide logistics support head of division and the team, CEO workshops, governance meetings, and be the contact point for building the Agile working environment. - Consolidate and prepare progress reports for BOM, BOD and related committees timely and accurately. B. Resource Management - Collaborate with stakeholders in Business Units / Divisions to identify high level resource planning requirements to ensure optimal resource utilization. - Track and control resource usage efficiency to ensure sufficiency for all units in division and for company initiatives within approved plan. C. Portfolio Management - Work with transformation initiative leads and teams to understand progress of their assigned portfolio and track the accuracy of inputs for tools. - Work with initiative leads to change initiative status and solve problems as required, report key challenges, track progress, recognize financial values and manage use of monitoring tools. - Proactively guide initiative teams, Business Units and Divisions for effective cross-functional collaboration. - Control quality and compliance of initiatives with required standards. - Escalate issues or risks of potential impact on performance via portfolio reporting to Sponsors, committees to facilitate the decision making process. - Support to develop Early Warning System (EWS).

Qualifications and Work Experience - At least 08 years of project or program management experience in Waterfall or Agile methodologies - Project or program management experience in a financial service or technology organization including product development, performance management, IT project implementation - Demonstrated experience working in a transformation office to drive a large organization-wide transformation program - Strong experience in performance tracking and management including operating rhythm of performance reviews - Strong knowledge and experience in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit large, complex, mission-critical, enterprise-level projects - Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Technology, Business, Banking and Finance or relevant discipline - Project management certification in PMP, PgMP will be advantageous

Operations Support and Governance - Design the operational process across the initiative lifecycle to ensure standartized approach across all type of initiatives/projects. - Update operational processes on a regular basis and facilitate the set up of new initiatives and tribes in accordance with required standards. - Support the development of tools/templates and guide initiative teams on how to fill in and update initiative progress on the tools/templates created. - Apply and maintain tools/templates used to track and report across the portfolio of transformation initiatives (Foundational and Agile), define monitoring tools/templates and customize as needed. - Provide logistics support head of division and the team, CEO workshops, governance meetings, and be the contact point for building the Agile working environment. - Consolidate and prepare progress reports for BOM, BOD and related committees timely and accurately. Resource Management - Collaborate with stakeholders in Business Units / Divisions to identify high level resource planning requirements to ensure optimal resource utilization. - Track and control resource usage efficiency to ensure sufficiency for all units in division and for company initiatives within approved plan. jd_text:
1. BỐI CẢNH VÀ NHIỆM VỤMetric.vn là startup công nghệ dữ liệu dẫn đầu mảng phân tích và cung cấp dữ liệu thị trường E-commerce cho các nhãn hàng (Brand) và công ty bán lẻ (Retail).Dữ liệu thị trường chỉ là một phần trong toàn bộ data system của một doanh nghiệp. Trong kỷ nguyên AI, mọi data system đều cần phải AI-ready - sao cho khi tích hợp ChatGPT, Claude hay Gemini thì các AI này luôn nắm bắt được context doanh nghiệp và hoạt động hiệu quả nhất. Một data system đã AI-ready như thế gọi là data brain, Metric đang tiếp tục hướng đến vị trí dẫn đầu trong việc cung cấp giải pháp data brain này. Tên sản phẩm: Smart BI.Với vai trò Senior PO, bạn có nhiệm vụ làm cho mỗi khách hàng có một Data Brain cho riêng họ thông qua sử dụng sản phẩm Smart BI này.2. VAI TRÒ VÀ TRÁCH NHIỆM- Sở hữu Product roadmap: Đảm bảo product roadmap luôn được cập nhật theo nhu cầu từ khách hàng và stakeholders. Chịu trách nhiệm deliver tới khách hàng và stakeholders (kinh doanh, công ty).- Chịu trách nhiệm về product values: Xây dựng feature list và PRD, đảm bảo bám sát nhất với nhu cầu thị trường, Khách hàng, kỳ vọng Kinh doanh của công ty.- Thiết kế tiêu chuẩn sản phẩm: Thiết kế logic, rule xử lý data và thiết kế UI/UX cho các luồng từ đồng bộ data đến khi được sử dụng thành công trong các AI Agents của khách hàng. Bạn cũng thiết kế các gói trả phí phù hợp theo nhu cầu kinh doanh.- Đồng thiết kế giải pháp Enterprise: Làm việc sát sườn với các Solution Consultant trong các deal Custom Enterprise lớn.- Đồng quản trị nguồn lực kỹ thuật: Cùng với Product Head, bạn dẫn dắt engineer team với tư cách owner của Product roadmap và PRD, nắm rõ nguồn lực engineering trong sản phẩm để thiết kế giá gói sản phẩm & quản lý rủi ro nợ kỹ thuật.- KPIs của bạn: Product values (stakeholders đánh giá); Feature adoption; Delivery SLA;

Kinh nghiệm bắt buộc:- Có ít nhất 4 năm kinh nghiệm làm Product Owner hoặc Senior Product Executive tại các công ty SaaS, ưu tiên các SaaS có tính chất phức tạp về luồng dữ liệu (ERP, CRM, CDP, Hệ thống quản lý bán hàng đa kênh);- Ít nhất 3 năm kinh nghiệm thiết kế các phần mềm hoặc hệ thống có tính năng Phân quyền người dùng và Quản trị dữ liệu phức tạp.- Ưu tiên: Ứng viên từng trải qua các vị trí tương tự về AI SaaS; PO gốc kỹ thuật chuyển định hướng Product & Customer; PO/PM của các SaaS ngành E-commerce & Digital.Năng lực chuyên môn:- Mạnh tư duy hệ thống và tối ưu.- Nhạy bén về data thương mại hoặc data phục vụ tăng trưởng.- Định hướng chuyên môn các sản phẩm data platform & ứng dụng AIVăn hóa & Tính cách:- Chủ động, quyết liệt, linh hoạt.- Khéo léo trong giao tiếp, phối hợp.- Kiên nhẫn, kiên định với tầm nhìn sản phẩm.- Học tập liên tục, dám nghĩ dám làm.

title: QA Engineer (Manual & Automation Tester)
company: DXC Vietnam
jd_text:
We are looking for a talented Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation Testing) to join our growing Quality Engineering team. In this role, you will work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and stakeholders to ensure the delivery of high-quality web and mobile applications. You will perform both manual and automated testing activities, contribute to quality improvements throughout the software development lifecycle, and help drive a quality-first mindset across Agile teams. You will have opportunities to work on enterprise-scale Banking and Insurance projects, utilizing modern testing tools, automation frameworks, API testing solutions, and CI/CD practices. Responsibilities Analyze business and system requirements to create comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scenarios. Perform functional, integration, regression, smoke, and user acceptance testing for web and mobile applications. Design, execute, and maintain automated test scripts to improve test coverage and efficiency. Conduct API testing and validate system integrations. Support shift-left testing practices by participating early in requirement reviews and development activities. Collaborate closely with developers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, and cross-functional teams in Agile/Scrum environments. Identify, document, track, and verify defects throughout the defect lifecycle. Review solution documentation and contribute to quality improvement initiatives. Prepare test execution reports and communicate testing progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders. Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes, automation frameworks, test data management, and testing standards.

Must Have 2-10 years of experience in Software Quality Assurance and Testing. Good English communication skills, both written and verbal. Strong experience in manual testing, including functional, integration, regression, and UAT testing. Hands-on experience with test automation for web, mobile, or API testing. Experience with at least one automation tool or framework such as: Selenium WebDriver Cypress Katalon Studio TestComplete Or similar automation frameworks Selenium WebDriver Cypress Katalon Studio TestComplete Or similar automation frameworks Experience with API testing using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, SoapUI, or equivalent. Solid understanding of SDLC, STLC, and QA best practices. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Experience using Jira and related collaboration/testing tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams. Nice to Have Experience with Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Groovy, Python, or similar programming languages. Experience with Mobile Automation Testing. Experience maintaining or enhancing automation frameworks. Knowledge of SQL and database testing. Experience with Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or CI/CD pipelines. Experience with test management tools such as Xray, Zephyr, qTest, or similar. Experience in Banking, Financial Services, or Insurance domains. ISTQB or relevant testing certifications.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst (Financial Services)
company: Zalopay
jd_text:
The Business Intelligence Analyst for the Credit Enablement team delivers the insights and data-driven recommendations that support the growth of Zalopay's lending products. You will own recurring analytical delivery and reconciliation while contributing to strategic analysis across product, marketing, and risk. This is not a query-service role — you own each piece of work end-to-end, from clarifying the question to landing the insight. 1. Operational Analytics & Reporting Ensure reporting accuracy through data validation, quality controls, standardized logic, and clear documentation. Handle ad-hoc analytical requests end-to-end — clarify scope, deliver validated output, and communicate results stakeholders can act on. 2. Deep-Dive Analysis & Business Insight Conduct deep-dive analyses on user acquisition, retention, churn, and risk metrics; investigate anomalies and communicate root causes with recommended actions. Measure the impact of implemented initiatives and continuously refine metrics and recommendations to support ongoing business improvement. 3. Analytics Infrastructure & Standards Collaborate with Data Platform, Data Service, and Risk teams to build and standardize shared data foundations - reusable layers, metric definitions, pipelines, and event tracking - so analysis stays consistent and scalable across the team.

﻿ Must Have Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field. 2+ years of hands-on BI/Data Analyst experience with end-to-end delivery ownership. Strong SQL proficiency, with hands-on experience extracting, transforming, and analyzing large and complex datasets. Experience with data modeling and analytical frameworks. Fundamental knowledge of statistical programming language (Python, R) to manipulate and draw insights from large data sets. Proactive and accountable - manages own timeline and multiple stakeholders, validates output before sending, and delivers under tight timelines without escalating every conflict. Nice to Have Prior experience in fintech, digital lending, digital payments.. Basic understanding of dimensional modeling (dim/fact tables, Star or Snowflake schema). Stay up-to-date with the latest data technologies and trends. Hands-on use of AI/GenAI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) in real analytics work.

title: IT Business Analyst (Agentic AI)
company: Live Payments
jd_text:
ABOUT US Live Payments is one of Australia's leading payment service providers, servicing thousands of businesses across Australia. We continue to innovate our payment solutions and expand our product offering alongside our industry leading strategic partners including Qantas Loyalty and Prospa. ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES Live Payments is seeking a mid-senior level Technical Business Analyst who can help implement strategy across this young and fast-growing company. This role is based in Ho Chi Minh City Vietnam, reporting to the Head of Software Development. Core duties include: Understanding and considering business and technical engineering/IT needs to ensure quality digital products and related operational workflows to meet/exceed the desired business objectives. Use agentic AI tools to accelerate requirements analysis, documentation, process mapping, and stakeholder communication Evaluate and recommend where AI agents can automate or improve existing business processes and product workflows Using data and process modelling tools (including, but not limited to, process mapping, activity diagram, and dataflow modelling) to analyse and translate business requirements into meaningful statements of work that is acceptable to both business and technology stakeholders. Performing system analysis activities (e.g., “as-is”, “to-be”, gap analysis) to ensure system and data integrity. Translating business requirements into functional, non-functional, and technical requirements includes business processes, workflow diagrams, use cases, user experience, and system access. Participating in system and application architecture design and evaluating solutions against business requirements. Providing support in testing activities, reviewing test cases and results, organising reviews, tracking feedback, and facilitating UAT when needed.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE University Degree Qualified in a Tech or Business field. 4 years’ experience working in similar roles. Experience working in the payment and financial service industry is advantageous. Proficiency in English KEY SKILLS Superior ability to translate business requirements into functional, non-functional, and technical requirements. Demonstrated experience using agentic AI tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, AI-powered analysis tools) as a productivity multiplier — not limited to basic AI chat Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and completeness in a business context Solid presentation, communication, and technical writing skills, with the ability to convey simple and complex information to technical and non-technical audiences at any level. Solid analytical, system thinking, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail. Excellent English skills in writing, reading, speaking, and listening. Adaptable, fast learner and proactive. Nice-to-have Skills Understanding of Agile and experience working in Agile-driven environments. Understanding the product development process, having a sense of product ownership and being passionate about building great products. Experienced in working with various aspects of technology solutions (e.g., user interfaces, mobility, API, databases, system integration) and dealing with technology specialists

location_raw: Ho Chi Minh - Da Nang - Ha Noi

KoalaDigital helps Australian businesses improve their websites, bookings and the systems around them, including payments, forms, automations and integrations. Understand system architecture and where and how different parts fit together. Take ownership of problems from investigation through to implementation and resolution. Work proactively, identify what needs to be done, and take initiative rather than waiting for new tasks from the Team Lead .

Strong Problem-Solving ability. Good spoken English , with the ability to propose and explain solutions. Proactive, can-do attitude , with a strong sense of initiative and ownership. Comfortable working in a consultant role . Nice-to-Have Experience working and helping directly with English-speaking clients . Experience with APIs, integrations or third-party services.

title: Data Engineer (Mobile App & AdTech / Data Platform)
company: CÔNG TY TNHH MAPLE LABS
jd_text:
ABOUT THE ROLE:As a Data Engineer, you will be a key driver in designing, scaling, and operating the data backbone across our entire Mobile Apps & Games ecosystem. You will be responsible for transforming tens of millions of raw event logs (in-app events, MMP tracking, ad network revenues) into robust Data Warehouse models, high-performance feature pipelines for ML/AI models (LTV forecasting, anomaly detection), and internal self-service analytics platforms for Product & Growth Squads.JOB DESCRIPTION:Build and operate end-to-end ELT/ETL data pipelines (batch & near-realtime) to ingest data from MMPs (Adjust, Qonversion), Ad Networks (Google Ads, AdMob, AppLovin, Mintegral, Apple Search Ads,...), and in-app event tracking into the Data Warehouse.Design schema architectures (Star/Snowflake), optimize complex analytical queries, partitioning, clustering, and storage costs on Google BigQuery and modern columnar databases.Build, scale, and maintain workflow orchestrations using Apache Airflow, Celery, Redis, and Docker on Cloud environments (GCP/Compute Engine).Develop custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, agent tools, and data APIs to connect LLMs and AI IDEs directly with data warehouses, documentation vaults, and internal systems.Construct reliable feature stores and datasets for Machine Learning/AI initiatives (LTV forecasting, payback modeling, anomaly detection) and assist in model serving pipelines.Implement data observability, automated monitoring, and data quality checks; develop internal data tools and self-service dashboards using Streamlit and Metabase/Looker Studio.Establish engineering best practices, data modeling standards, and comprehensive documentation (Data Dictionaries, Architecture Blueprints).

REQUIREMENTS:3+ yearsof hands-on data engineering experience building and maintaining production data pipelines.Strong proficiency in Python for high-performance data processing and advanced SQL (performance tuning, window functions, complex transformations).Solid experience with Google BigQuery (or modern columnar stores like ClickHouse, Snowflake, Redshift), including query optimization and cost management.Practical experience with Apache Airflow, Celery/Redis, Docker/containerization, CI/CD workflows, and Cloud platforms (GCP preferred).AI-First & Vibe Coding Mindset: Daily hands-on experience using AI coding assistants and AI IDEs (Cursor, Claude Code, Antigravity, etc.) to rapidly prototype, build, and ship production-grade code at high velocity.Hands-on experience or strong interest in building/integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, custom tools, and AI workflows for data engineering tasks.Strong ownership, problem-solving abilities, clear communication, and effective collaboration with Product Owners, Data Analysts, and Leadership.Nice to have:Domain knowledge in Mobile Apps, Games, or Digital Advertising / AdTech (MMP attribution, Ad Network APIs, eCPM, ROAS, LTV).Experience building internal web tools or BI applications using Streamlit.Familiarity with ML lifecycles, BigQuery ML, or LLM serving infrastructure and token monitoring.Experience with workflow automation APIs (Google Apps Script, Slack webhooks, third-party integrations).

title: Senior Golang Developer (AI, JSON, SQL, Linux)
company: PERSOL CROSS TECHNOLOGY VIETNAM CO., LTD.
jd_text:
We are looking for a Senior Golang Developer to join our engineering team and support the development, enhancement, and production operation of an enterprise AI Chatbot and AI Agent platform. The role will primarily focus on Go/Golang backend development, building and maintaining scalable services, REST APIs, and integrations with AI services, enterprise systems, databases, and knowledge platforms. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Go/Golang. Build and support RESTful APIs and integrations with internal and external systems. Work with microservices and multi-service architectures. Integrate backend services with AI/LLM and RAG-based knowledge systems. Support knowledge ingestion, retrieval, and AI service integrations. Work with SQL databases and troubleshoot data-related issues. Investigate and resolve production issues across applications, APIs, and services. Improve application performance, reliability, and scalability. Work with Docker, Linux, and containerized deployment environments. Participate in code reviews, testing, documentation, and technical knowledge sharing.

A. MUST-HAVE SKILLS 6+ years of software development experience, including at least 3 years of hands on experience working on Go/Golang projects. Strong hands-on experience with Go/Golang and backend development. Experience building and maintaining production-grade backend services. Strong experience with REST APIs, HTTP/HTTPS, JSON, and API integrations. Experience with microservices or distributed service architectures. Experience with SQL and relational databases. Experience with Docker and Linux environments. Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and production support skills. Experience with authentication and API security, such as JWT and tokenbased authentication. Practical experience or good understanding of AI/LLM applications and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). Strong problem-solving and communication skills. English skills: Intermediate proficiency in reading and writing, communication skills for day-to-day business interactions. B. NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS Experience with .NET / C# / ASP.NET Core Web API. Experience with AI Agent or Agentic AI development. Experience with LLM platforms such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar. Experience with vector databases or vector search. Experience with Kubernetes, Redis, Kafka, or RabbitMQ. Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, or Jaeger. Experience working with enterprise systems and complex API integrations

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (System Development, CI/CD)
company: Motorola Solutions
jd_text:
As a System Development Engineer, you sit at the high-velocity intersection of Software Engineering and Systems Architecture, building the sophisticated tooling that allows our systems to provide the highest quality service. You will design and implement world-class Continuous Integration and Deployment frameworks. You will treat our internal infrastructure as a product, developing high-performance internal tools, APIs, and CLI utilities to automate complex operational logic. You will lead the charge in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and build self-healing systems and automated remediation workflows that detect and fix issues before a human ever sees an alert. You’ll bake security into the DNA of our systems. Architecting the CI/CD Engine: Design, build, and optimize high-speed deployment pipelines. You ensure it’s tested, secured, and deployed with zero downtime using Canary and Blue/Green strategies. Engineering Internal Platforms: You will treat internal services as products, developing APIs, custom CLI tools, and dashboards that empower software teams to self-serve infrastructure. Radical Automation & IaC : Eliminate manual toil by codifying everything. You will manage global-scale infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), ensuring environments are reproducible, version-controlled, and immutable. Advanced Escalation & Reliability: Act as the "Engineer’s Engineer." You provide support for complex distributed systems failures, performing deep-dive root cause analysis (RCA) and writing code to ensure the same failure mode never happens twice. Performance Tuning & Observability: Build the "eyes and ears" of our systems. You will implement advanced telemetry, distributed tracing, and automated alerting to maintain high availability and peak performance. Replicate complex customer deployment environments to execute comprehensive system integration and stability testing. Cybersecurity Compliance & Global Standards : Ensure that our systems meet/exceed strict global security standards.

Education & Experience 8+ years of experience in system development, integration engineering, or QA automation. Bachelor Degree/Master Degree in Software Engineering/ Computer Science/ Information Technology or any relevant field. ​ Technical Competencies Proficiency in object oriented and scripting programming languages Strong Linux/Unix internals knowledge and a firm grasp of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/3). ​ Language & Soft Skills Advanced verbal and written English communication skills are required. Strong analytical mind with a proactive approach to breaking down and solving complex technical puzzles. Constant learner who proactively works through ambiguity ​ What We Offer The unique opportunity to build and pioneer global security products directly out of Vietnam's thriving innovation center. An international, diverse, and multicultural R&D culture guided by world-class data scientists and chief engineers. Competitive salary and bonuses.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
company: Cty CP Truyền Thông Thiên Phước
jd_text:
Phát triển, bảo trì và tối ưu các dịch vụ Backend phục vụ Web, Mobile và Game.Thiết kế, phát triển và duy trì các RESTful API đảm bảo hiệu năng, bảo mật và khả năng mở rộng.Thiết kế và phát triển các dịch vụ WebSocket/Realtime phục vụ các tính năng như game online, thông báo thời gian thực, chat, matchmaking và đồng bộ trạng thái.Thiết kế cơ sở dữ liệu, tối ưu truy vấn, xây dựng cấu trúc dữ liệu phù hợp với từng bài toán và đảm bảo hiệu năng hệ thống.Xây dựng các hệ thống xử lý bất đồng bộ (Asynchronous Processing) sử dụng Queue hoặc Message Broker khi cần.Tích hợp và phát triển các dịch vụ kết nối với hệ thống bên thứ ba thông qua API.Tham gia phát triển và tích hợp các tính năng AI/LLM vào sản phẩm như chatbot, AI Agent, tìm kiếm thông minh, OCR và các ứng dụng AI khác.Tích hợp các mô hình AI thông qua API hoặc mô hình tự triển khai; phối hợp xây dựng AI Workflow khi cần.Tối ưu hiệu năng Backend, giảm thời gian phản hồi, tối ưu tài nguyên hệ thống và nâng cao khả năng chịu tải.Thiết kế hệ thống có khả năng mở rộng (Scalable Architecture), đảm bảo tính ổn định, bảo mật và khả năng bảo trì lâu dài.Phân tích yêu cầu, đề xuất giải pháp kỹ thuật phù hợp với định hướng phát triển sản phẩm.

- Có từ 3 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển Backend.- Thành thạo Node.js (NestJS hoặc ExpressJS).- Thành thạo JavaScript/TypeScript.- Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với MySQL và Redis.- Có kinh nghiệm xây dựng RESTful API.- Có kinh nghiệm xây dựng và tối ưu WebSocket hoặc các giao thức realtime.- Có tư duy thiết kế database và tối ưu truy vấn.- Hiểu về Authentication (JWT, OAuth...).- Thành thạo Git.Ưu tiên- Có kinh nghiệm thiết kế hệ thống realtime phục vụ lượng kết nối đồng thời lớn.- Có kinh nghiệm với Docker.- Có kinh nghiệm sử dụng RabbitMQ, Kafka hoặc các hệ thống Message Queue.- Đã từng phát triển Game Backend hoặc Multiplayer Server.- Có kinh nghiệm tích hợp các LLM như OpenAI, Gemini, Claude hoặc các mô hình mã nguồn mở.- Có kinh nghiệm phát triển AI Agent, MCP hoặc AI Workflow.- Có hiểu biết về RAG, Embedding hoặc Vector Database.

- Có từ 3 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển Backend.- Thành thạo Node.js (NestJS hoặc ExpressJS).- Thành thạo JavaScript/TypeScript.- Có kinh nghiệm làm việc với MySQL và Redis.- Có kinh nghiệm xây dựng RESTful API.- Có kinh nghiệm xây dựng và tối ưu WebSocket hoặc các giao thức realtime.- Có tư duy thiết kế database và tối ưu truy vấn.- Hiểu về Authentication (JWT, OAuth...).- Thành thạo Git.Ưu tiên- Có kinh nghiệm thiết kế hệ thống realtime phục vụ lượng kết nối đồng thời lớn.- Có kinh nghiệm với Docker.- Có kinh nghiệm sử dụng RabbitMQ, Kafka hoặc các hệ thống Message Queue.- Đã từng phát triển Game Backend hoặc Multiplayer Server.- Có kinh nghiệm tích hợp các LLM như OpenAI, Gemini, Claude hoặc các mô hình mã nguồn mở.- Có kinh nghiệm phát triển AI Agent, MCP hoặc AI Workflow.- Có hiểu biết về RAG, Embedding hoặc Vector Database.

title: Junior Business Analyst (Fluent English)
company: Wilmar CLV (Cambodia Laos Vietnam)
jd_text:
The major role & responsibilities includes: Collect and analyze the requirements for product and solution from internal/external customer through research, interviews, and regular feedbacks Contribute to requirement gathering, user clarifications, IT walkthrough and ensure quality delivery Monitor the progress of project development and assist Delivery Manager in task planning and scope/CR management Provide professional documentation for product and solution such as BRD, Business workflow/data flow, etc Produce detailed product and functional requirements that will drive product development, testing and deployment Work with development teams to align on project schedules, manages feature delivery, and ensure implementing effective and efficient business solutions Have the ability to research new technologies and technical difficulties Establish and maintain professional and consultative relationships with internal/external clients, communicate with business stakeholders throughout project lifecycle Maintain expertise and knowledge of business domain, technologies, and solutions Perform risk management to minimize the project risks Support to evaluate the outcomes/deliverables of project as established during the planning phase Write testing scenarios for UAT, support UAT and verifying bugs/issues Perform related work as assigned by direct line manager

title: Product Manager (Sản Phẩm AMIS Operation)
company: ProCông ty Cổ phần MISA
jd_text:
MISA đang tìm kiếm Product Manager để dẫn dắt và phát triển phần mềm phục vụ công tác vận hành của Doanh nghiệp như quản lý phòng họp, văn thư, truyền thông nội bộ,.., dự án:Nghiên cứu thị trường, đối thủ, hành vi khách hàng để cải tiến sản phẩm;Phân tích dữ liệu và nhu cầu thực tế để đề xuất giải pháp sản phẩm mang lại giá trị cao cho khách hàng;Xây dựng và phát triển các tính năng cho hệ thống;Phối hợp cùng các bộ phận liên quan (Engineering Manager, Product Owner, các bộ phận liên quan) để đảm bảo sản phẩm phát triển đúng định hướng, đúng tiến độ và đạt chất lượng;Phối hợp với bộ phận Marketing & Sales phát triển khách hàng và thị trường, giúp đạt được mục tiêu kinh doanh công ty đề ra;Phối hợp với bộ phận Onboarding (Triển khai), Chăm sóc khách hàng để thấu hiểu khách hàng sử dụng phần mềm, thấu hiểu quy trình triển khai nhằm tìm kiếm ý tưởng, cải tiến sản phẩm giúp rút ngắn thời gian triển khai, giảm yêu cầu hỗ trợ, tăng mức độ hài lòng của khách hàng, nâng cao tỷ lệ sử dụng và tỷ lệ gia hạn.

Must haveTốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành Quản trị kinh doanh, Kinh tế, Quản trị… từ các trường ĐH Ngoại thương, ĐH Kinh tế quốc dân, Học viện Tài chính, ĐH Quốc gia…Có kinh nghiệm tối thiểu từ 2 năm làm Product Manager/Product Owner hoặc vai trò/công việc tương đương tại các công ty phần mềmNice to haveCó kĩ năng:Tìm hiểu và nghiên cứu thị trường.Nghiên cứu tâm lý, hành vi và thói quen của khách hàng, người sử dụng.Phân tích và ra quyết định.Quản lý yêu cầu và ưu tiên yêu cầu.Lập kế hoạch: Kế hoạch kinh doanh, triển khai, phát triển sản phẩm...Yêu thích và định hướng lâu dài, làm việc gắn bó trong lĩnh vực phát triển sản phẩm công nghệ, quan tâm đến việc sử dụng công nghệ để nâng cao hiệu quả công việc. Có mong muốn phát triển sản phẩm để mang lại giá trị cho xã hội.Năng động, linh hoạt, thích đi triển khai thực tế tại khách hàng để cải tiến sản phẩm.Ưu tiên các ứng viên có bằng MBA.

title: Senior/Middle Machine Learning Engineer
company: M_Service (MoMo)
jd_text:
About the team MoMo is the market leader in mobile payments in Vietnam. We strive to make all transactions fast, easy and joyful. We are looking for an experienced Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing Big Data & AI team. At MoMo, we are making Machine Learning the core component to almost every part of the product - Risk Scoring, Fraud Detection, Financial Services, Engagement & Personalization and Expense Management . As a Machine Learning expert, you will have a unique opportunity to have a high impact by building these systems, as well as uncovering new opportunities to apply Machine Learning to impact millions of users. You will: Work with Data Scientists to build Machine Learning systems using your engineering experience. As an example, suppose that we want to build a fraud detection system, you will take care of building the services necessary for retrieving user history, transforming data, applying machine learning models and connecting to other services for appropriate actions. In some situations, you can build the whole Machine Learning application from end to end; Design and building data pipelines that serve Machine Learning models; Provide a platform that is super easy for Data Scientists to explore new features, build models and conduct A/B tests; Build framework for monitoring Machine Learning systems.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field. 3+ years of industry experience in machine learning; Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with tabular processing libraries (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, PySpark/Polars) and GBDT frameworks (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost). In-depth understanding of the complete modeling lifecycle: data gathering, feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, model serving, and post-deployment monitoring. Proficiency in PyTorch or TensorFlow for building custom neural architectures and tabular deep learning models. Ability to read, reproduce, and extend recent research papers. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

title: Backend Engineer
company: Parcel Perform
jd_text:
In love with Python and want to utilize it for B2B software solutions in e-commerce logistics? Parcel Perform is looking for an amazing team member to support us in software engineering! You have good web development skills, 4+ years of experience in Back-end development, you’re technically savvy, and have a nice grasp on coding techniques? Are you also interested in e-commerce and like to take on new challenges? Help us drive Parcel Perform’s growth and join our team! We are looking for you! WE NEED YOU ON OUR TEAM! WE NEED YOU ON OUR TEAM! As a Backend Engineer , you will be building scalable systems with microservices. You will write focused, high-performance codebases that are small and do one thing well, contributing to the resilience and scalability of our service ecosystem. Operating at this level means working in a complex environment involving high-frequency service communication, advanced automation, and a vast landscape of metrics. We choose microservices for technology freedom, resilience, and scalability. Such a system isn’t easy, especially with a focus on good engineering practices. But that is ok. We are here for people who want to operate at the next level in their careers.

WHAT YOU SHOULD BRING ALONG! Must-have Requirements: Core Languages: Solid knowledge of Backend, preferably Python or Scala . We are open to experts in other languages (Java, Go, Rust…) who are eager to master our stack. Experience: 4+ years of professional experience in Software Development with a focus on Backend systems. System Scaling: Knowledge of scaling practices such as in-memory databases, load balancing, and caching. Database Proficiency: Comfortable with both SQL and NoSQL databases. Communication Protocols: Comfortable with RESTful and real-time communication protocols. Engineering Mindset: Clear understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and design patterns. Passionate about code quality, productivity, and maintainability. Nice-to-have Requirements: Infrastructure: Familiarity with the AWS stack to get the most out of cloud infrastructure. Middleware: Hands-on know-how of any Message Queue (MQ) as a critical communication hub. If you start one today, that still counts. Data Engineering: An eagerness to contribute to the data engineering process in an AI-first environment. Full-stack Exposure: Wide exposure to multiple technology stacks is an advantage — we love full-stack engineers. English Communication: Good spoken and written English to collaborate smoothly with international teams and stakeholders.

title: Java Developer (Middle - Senior)
company: SAVIS Vietnam
jd_text:
Tham gia phát triển và vận hành các hệ thống Web API trên nền tảng Java Spring Boot. Thiết kế, xây dựng và tối ưu các dịch vụ backend đảm bảo hiệu năng và khả năng mở rộng. Tích hợp với các hệ thống liên quan như Identity Server, SSO và các hệ thống nghiệp vụ khác. Làm việc với Redis, Kafka, JWT trong các bài toán xử lý dữ liệu và xác thực. Triển khai, vận hành hệ thống trên môi trường Linux. Tham gia đóng gói và triển khai ứng dụng bằng Docker, Kubernetes, Rancher2. Hỗ trợ xử lý sự cố, tối ưu hệ thống và đảm bảo tính ổn định của dịch vụ. Phối hợp với team Frontend, BA, DevOps để hoàn thành dự án đúng tiến độ. Có thể tham gia phát triển giao diện đơn giản bằng Angular hoặc ReactJS khi cần.

title: Full-stack Developer
company: Simpson Strong-Tie Vietnam
jd_text:
You want to be a key member of a strong team of creators who take pride in their work and support one another. As a Software Developer , you will take ownership of features across the stack — from API and data model through to the UI that consumes them — across Simpson Strong-Tie's enterprise platforms. We don't split our team into backend and frontend silos; everyone here is a software developer who can move across the stack. This is a mid-level role, so we're not expecting you to already be equally strong everywhere: backend is where we need your core strength, and we'll support you in growing your frontend range over time. Specializing deeper into backend or frontend later is a welcome career choice, not a requirement from day one. Your impact will be recognized, and if career growth is important to you, we not only know how to support your development — we're passionate about it. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Full-Stack Feature Ownership Design, build, and maintain RESTful APIs and services using Java/Spring Boot and/or .NET/ASP.NET Core. Contribute to the UI features that consume those APIs, using React/Next.js and TypeScript. Write clean, testable, well-structured code following SOLID principles and established architectural patterns (controller/service/repository). Design and optimize data models across relational (Azure SQL/MSSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (Cosmos DB) databases, with attention to indexing and query performance. Integrate services with internal and third-party APIs, message queues, and background/async processing. Write unit and integration tests for the code you ship. Participate in code reviews, troubleshoot production issues, and contribute to system reliability and performance improvements across the stack. AI-Augmented Development Leverage AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate development while maintaining code quality. Use AI tools effectively for code review, refactoring, debugging, and documentation across the stack. Critically evaluate AI output, knowing when to trust, verify, or override. Collaboration & Quality Work closely with tech leads, QA, and product owners within our Scrum framework with daily standups, sprint planning, and retros. Own your tickets end-to-end, including breaking work into and managing subtasks, you're expected to drive a ticket, not just take direction on it. Embrace collective code ownership with code review, improve, and take responsibility for shared implementation. Raise blockers, risks, and improvement ideas proactively, rather than waiting to be asked. Look for opportunities to improve code quality, team processes, and your own skills as part of your normal workflow, not as a separate initiative. Write and maintain clear technical documentation for APIs, services, and data models. Participate in sprint planning, estimation, and delivery commitments as part of a cross-functional team.

DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE The list below reflects what's required to be considered and what strengthens an application. Must-Have 2-4 years of professional software development experience, with solid backend fundamentals as the core of your background. Strong proficiency in Java/Spring Boot (Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA) and/or C#/.NET (ASP.NET Core, EF Core). Working knowledge of TypeScript and React/Next.js and comfortable contributing to UI features alongside your backend work; deep independence here is something you can grow into. Solid understanding of relational database design (MySQL or MSSQL/Azure SQL) with schema design, indexing, query optimization. Basic knowledge of unit testing (JUnit, xUnit/NUnit, or Jest). Understanding of RESTful API design principles and experience integrating with third-party or internal APIs. Experience working in a Scrum team includes daily standups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and estimation. Comfortable owning tickets and features across the stack rather than working strictly within one layer. Business-level English communication skills (both verbal and written) Nice-to-Have Familiarity with both Java/Spring Boot and .NET, rather than one of the two. If you already lean toward specializing deeper in backend or frontend, that's welcome. Exposure to Cosmos DB or other NoSQL stores. Familiarity with Git-based workflows, code review practices, and CI/CD pipelines. Basic exposure to cloud platforms (Azure preferred) including App Services, Function Apps, or containerized deployments (AKS/Docker). Experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) in daily work. Familiarity with web security principles and common vulnerabilities (XSS, CSRF, SQL Injection).

title: System Engineer (Server/Storage/SAN)
company: SHINHAN DS
jd_text:
We are looking for a System Engineer to join Shinhan DS Vietnam. This role is not a system administrator position. we are seeking a hands-on field engineer who will directly install and build IT infrastructure on-site. The candidate must be capable of seamlessly performing the physical deployment and configuration of servers, operating systems, storage, and SAN switches at customer sites. Additionally, you will be required to collaborate with project teams and group affiliates to design infrastructure and resolve technical issues. Key Responsibilities Infra System Field Engineering Execution Directly install and build systems, including server installation, OS installation, SAN switch installation, and storage installation. Design and implement project IT infrastructure (servers, storage, SAN, network connectivity). Analyze requirements and perform OS configuration (Windows, Linux). Conduct troubleshooting and resolve issues for systems. Prepare and review equipment quotations.

Requirements At least 3 years of experience as a System Engineer or a Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or Electronics & Telecommunications. Strong, proven, hands-on field engineering experience personally performed—including server installation, OS installation, storage installation, and SAN switch installation (must be your own direct experience, not observed or managed). Strong troubleshooting skills in system and infrastructure environments. Experience in preparing quotations and performing cost estimation for IT infrastructure deployment. Good English communication skills to collaborate effectively with international vendors and partners. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience building/implementing backup solutions (personally performed). Your CV must clearly demonstrate the deployment, installation, and troubleshooting work you personally carried out (servers, OS, storage, SAN switches). Applications without clear, self-performed field experience will not be considered.

title: Software Engineer (Java)
company: Zalopay
jd_text:
Bank Solutions is the technical foundation of Zalopay’s integration with banks and financial institutions, enabling high-performance services such as account linking, deposits, withdrawals, transfers, and more. Our systems handle millions of real-time financial transactions daily with extreme reliability, security, and scalability. We're looking for a highly skilled and driven Software Engineer who shares our passion for innovation in the fintech space. You'll be instrumental in designing, developing, and optimizing both the frontend user interfaces and the high-traffic backend systems. What You'll Do: End-to-End Development: Design and develop robust, scalable backend services (primarily Java/Golang) that power our financial products, and build intuitive frontend applications to deliver seamless user experiences. Quality Assurance: Ensure high code quality through comprehensive unit testing, thorough execution for both frontend and backend components. Problem Solver: Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues and errors promptly across the entire application stack, ensuring continuous and efficient operation. Documentation Guru: Contribute to and maintain up-to-date system documentation, sharing your knowledge effectively with the team.

Requirements: At least 2+ years of hands-on experience as a full-stack Software Engineer in a complex, enterprise-level development environment. Strong proficiency in Java 8+ and modern Java frameworks like Spring Boot 2+ for backend development. Proven experience in integrating and developing APIs. Experience working with both relational (e.g., MySQL, Oracle) and non-relational data stores (e.g. Redis). Familiarity with distributed, event-driven systems, including messaging protocols and middleware like RabbitMQ and Apache Kafka A deep understanding of OOP principles and key design patterns. Strong understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, networking, and experience with CI/CD Understanding of AI fundamentals and experience leveraging AI-assisted tools to improve development productivity and workflow efficiency. Bonus Points For: Hands-on experience with Golang. Experience in frontend development using ReactJS. Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban). Experience or knowledge of e-wallet, e-payment, e-banking, or the broader finance industry is a significant advantage If you're ready to make a tangible impact on the fintech landscape in Vietnam, grow your IT expertise, and thrive in a dynamic environment, apply now!

title: Trưởng Phòng Kỹ Thuật
company: CÔNG TY CỔ PHẦN CÔNG NGHỆ GIẢI PHÁP THI THIÊN
jd_text:
Dẫn dắt đội ngũ kỹ thuật (Deployment/Presales/Support) trong việc thiết kế, triển khai và vậnhành các giải pháp hạ tầng CNTT cho khách hàng doanh nghiệp.Trực tiếp tham gia khảo sát, tư vấn giải pháp kỹ thuật (presales) cho các dự án về server, storage, network, ảo hóa, bảo mật.Chịu trách nhiệm về chất lượng thiết kế kỹ thuật (technical design), phương án triển khai(deployment plan) và tài liệu bàn giao dự án.Phân công, giám sát và hỗ trợ kỹ thuật cho các thành viên trong nhóm trong quá trình triển khai dự án tại khách hàng.Đào tạo, kèm cặp (mentor) nhân sự kỹ thuật junior/mid-level; xây dựng quy trình, checklist kỹ thuật chuẩn hóa theo hướng ISO.Làm việc trực tiếp với các hãng công nghệ (HPE, Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, VMware, IBM...) để cập nhật giải pháp, chứng chỉ, chương trình partner.Xử lý các vấn đề kỹ thuật phức tạp/escalation từ đội vận hành hoặc khách hàng.Phối hợp với các bộ phận Kinh doanh, Dự án, Cung ứng để đảm bảo tiến độ và chất lượng bàn giao.

Tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành CNTT, Điện tử - Viễn thông hoặc tương đương.Tối thiểu 5 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực hạ tầng CNTT doanh nghiệp, trong đó có ít nhất 2 năm ở vai trò lead/trưởng nhóm kỹ thuật.Đã từng triển khai thực tế các dự án hạ tầng quy mô vừa và lớn (ngân hàng, bệnh viện, chứng khoán, khu công nghiệp...).Có khả năng đọc hiểu tài liệu kỹ thuật tiếng Anh; giao tiếp tiếng Anh cơ bản là lợi thế.Có khả năng làm việc dưới áp lực, sẵn sàng đi công tác/onsite khi cần.

title: Software Engineer ( C/C++/Java, Linux/ Android)
company: IriTech Vietnam
jd_text:
IriTech Incorporation is the global leader in iris recognition technology, delivering advanced biometric solutions including high-performance iris cameras, portable authentication devices, OEM modules, and iris recognition software for governments, enterprises, and emerging applications in mobile, automotive, AR/VR, and more. To support our innovative software development and integration of iris biometrics into diverse platforms, we are seeking a talented Software Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize software for IriTech's iris recognition solutions, ensuring secure, reliable, and high-performance operation across Windows, Linux, and Android environments. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain software applications and SDKs for iris biometric devices, including portable scanners, enrollment cameras, and OEM modules. Integrate software solutions with underlying firmware and hardware platforms running on Windows, Linux, and Android. Design and implement robust application programming interfaces (APIs) for biometric authentication and data processing. Conduct debugging, testing, and performance tuning on target software platforms. Research, evaluate, and implement new software technologies to enhance application performance and security. Collaborate with hardware, firmware, and product teams to deliver software for government projects (e.g., national ID programs) and commercial biometric solutions. Document software architecture, implementation details, and contribute to internal knowledge sharing.

Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field from a reputable university. 3+ years of professional experience in software development (fresh graduates with strong relevant projects and skills will be considered). Proficiency in C/C++ programming, alongside other relevant languages like Java or C#. Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, and software architecture. Experience developing applications and system services for Windows, Linux, or Android. Experience with debugging tools and version control (Git). Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work with technical documentation. Good English communication skills (written and spoken). Team-oriented mindset: diligent, reliable, dynamic, and collaborative.

title: Principal Software Engineer (LLM Agents)
company: Gradion
location_raw: Ho Chi Minh - Da Nang - Others
jd_text:
We’re hiring rockstars. We're looking for engineers who still like the hard problems. Gradion is hiring a Principal AI/System Architect (LLM Agents) to work across our teams and projects on the things that need serious engineering judgment: architecture, system design, scalability, performance, reliability, technical debt, and new technology. This is a hands-on individual contributor role . You'll design systems, write code, prototype ideas, debug the failures nobody else can reproduce, review the implementations that matter, and work alongside engineers and Tech Leads wherever deeper expertise is needed. Your influence here won't come from managing people. It comes from the systems you improve, the technical decisions you shape, and the engineers who get better for having worked with you. AI is part of the job We're building an AI-first engineering organization, and we want to get further than AI-assisted coding. You'll work with LLMs, AI APIs, agents, RAG, and evaluation, applied to problems in our own engineering and in the products we build for clients. We're not trying to put AI into everything. We want to find the places where it pays off, build those properly, and write down what we learn so other teams can pick it up. What this role is really about Own architecture and design decisions on the hardest systems in our portfolio Write code, prototype, and debug alongside the teams rather than from a distance Review the implementations that carry the most risk, and raise the bar through the work itself Find where AI pays off, build it properly, and turn what works into something other teams can reuse Work with Tech Leads on scalability, performance, reliability, and technical debt Evaluate new technology, prototype it, make a call, and write down the reasoning Work with clients and non-engineering stakeholders to turn vague problems into technical direction

10+ years building and running production software, and still writing code today Depth in system design and architecture: scalability, performance, distributed systems, reliability A track record of setting technical direction across several teams, or on one large and long-running program Quick to find your way around an unfamiliar codebase. Deep in at least one language and comfortable in several Tech stack (not strictly limited to): Python, Go, Node.js, Java, Cloud Native (AWS/GCP), Docker/Kubernetes... Hands-on experience with LLM-based systems. Things you have built, not only read about: AI APIs, prompt and context design, and at least one of agents, RAG, or evaluation Judgment about when not to build something, when to pay down debt, and when to say no The ability to mentor senior engineers and change their minds without formal authority Comfort working directly with clients and non-engineering stakeholders A habit of following where the field is going Nice to have Production AI systems at scale: evaluation harnesses, guardrails, cost and latency tuning Depth in one of our domains: data platforms, cybersecurity, robotics, enterprise systems Internal tooling or platform work that made other teams faster Open source contributions, conference talks, or technical writing
